【3】# 第九章　精囊与前列腺疾病并发症/第四节　开放性前列腺切除术并发症/十、术中意外损伤

【4】十、术中意外损伤

【5】（一）直肠损伤

【6】【预防】

【7】术者在前列腺包膜内剥离时，手感境界清晰可辨，如遇有粘连较重者，应由助手或台下医生，将手指插入肛门，将腺体向上举起便于术者在直视下剥离，既可彻底将腺体整块剜出，又能保持直肠免受损伤。

【8】【治疗】

【9】一旦术中发现直肠损伤，当即在严密的消毒下，将前列腺包膜与直肠之间的狄农维利埃筋膜外分离，选修补直肠壁，后缝合前列腺包膜，周围放置引流，减少感染。术后置放高位肛管减低直肠压力，禁食1周，同时加用广谱抗生素，预防和控制感染。如遇损伤较大，术中修补把握不大者，当行乙状结肠腹壁造瘘，粪路改道，3个月后行Ⅱ期直肠膀胱瘘的修补术，术后如确定瘘管修复成功，则可择期恢复肠道通路。

【10】（二）输尿管损伤

【11】【预防】

【12】术中打开膀胱，首先查看双侧管口位置，如位置较低，靠近颈口，先在双侧管口缝一针可吸收线作为标志或先用输尿管导管插入以防误缝。术中如疑有误缝管口，则可静脉推呋塞米40mg观察喷尿的情况或静脉注射靛胭脂，观察管口位置。

【13】【治疗】

【14】如已确定被误闭时，则应立即拆除缝线，恢复管口畅通。发现被严重撕裂者当即修补，如修补困难者，行输尿管膀胱再植术。

【15】# 第九章　精囊与前列腺疾病并发症/第四节　开放性前列腺切除术并发症/十一、耻骨骨髓炎

【16】十一、耻骨骨髓炎

【17】【概述】

【18】大概发生于术后4～6周，病人有低烧，局部和下腹部疼痛，检查中发现耻骨联合部和骨盆压痛，特别在大腿内收时有疼痛加重。

【19】【治疗】

【20】选用大剂量广谱抗生素控制感染，局部充分引流，同时加用激素治疗，1个月后即可痊愈出院。

【21】【预防】

【22】术中注意保护髂静脉，术后劝病人翻身，多做床上活动，起床要缓慢，排便时不能过于用力。术前预测血液黏稠度高的患者，应及时服用阿司匹林等抗凝药物预防血栓形成。

【23】# 第九章　精囊与前列腺疾病并发症/第四节　开放性前列腺切除术并发症/十二、性功能障碍

【24】十二、性功能障碍

【25】【概述】

【26】性功能障碍主要表现为逆行射精，性功能减退及勃起性阳痿。

【27】【诊断】

【28】应详细检查属精神因素所致的抑郁症或神经损伤或血管病变和性激素等因素。

【29】【治疗】

【30】分别给予对症治疗，可收到一定的效果。

【31】# 第九章　精囊与前列腺疾病并发症/第五节　根治性经会阴前列腺切除术并发症/

【32】第五节　根治性经会阴前列腺切除术并发症

【33】# 第九章　精囊与前列腺疾病并发症/第五节　根治性经会阴前列腺切除术并发症/一、术中并发症

【34】一、术中并发症

【35】（一）前列腺长牵引器不能顺利插入

【36】可用手指在阴囊处或插入直肠引导牵引器通过括约肌及前列腺；如失败，则用20F尿道探子探明后尿道方向后再插入牵引器；如仍失败可改插25F气囊尿管作为牵引。

【37】（二）分离太靠前

【38】需注意会阴横肌，如遇到会阴横肌或尿道球部表明分离太靠前，应撤回重新紧贴直肠分离。否则，尿道球部会出现较多出血，易损伤尿生殖膈。

【39】（三）直肠损伤

【40】对此并发症应有警惕性，一旦损伤应寻长穿孔部位。黏膜下出血或直肠黏膜隆起部位往往是真正的危险部位，如已穿孔可等手术完成后再修补。有时虽然尚未切开尿道，直肠损伤后手术仍可继续进行。术后给予低渣饮食及大便软化剂，行膀胱穿刺造瘘引流尿液，很少需行结肠造口。

【41】（四）输尿管损伤

【42】分离膀胱与精囊间隙时在三角区后方可能损伤输尿管，分离膀胱颈后壁水平太高也可能损伤，静脉注射靛胭脂可识别出输尿管口的位置，关闭膀胱颈时容易使输尿管梗阻，如有疑问，可放置输尿管支架管自会阴切口引出。

【43】# 第九章　精囊与前列腺疾病并发症/第五节　根治性经会阴前列腺切除术并发症/二、术后并发症

【44】二、术后并发症

【45】（一）再置尿管

【46】如尿管过早脱出或术后10～12日拔除后患者不能自行排尿，需再插入尿管。可先静脉注射地西泮，经尿道注入润滑油，用手指在直肠内小心地将尿管导入膀胱。也可先用一较细的直尿道探子探明尿道的方向，也可在麻醉下用内腔镜导入，但最好行膀胱穿刺造瘘。

【47】（二）尿道直肠瘘

【48】直肠损伤术后未及时发现和修补会出现尿道直肠瘘，可先留置尿管，予低渣饮食，以减少肠活动并观察几日。如在术后2周内发现可经直肠修补，扩张括约肌并找到穿孔部位，直视下修补。会阴部旋转引流管以免脓肿形成。如失败，可等待3～4个月后再行修补。对较大的瘘道可在术后1～2日内在直视下经直肠修补，也可等4～6个月后再手术。最安全的方法是在修复前行结肠造口和膀胱造瘘。如修补很细致，结肠造口也不一定必要。用大便软化剂可避免便秘，绝不能灌肠，因直肠内插管会造成损伤。

【49】（三）输尿管梗阻

【50】可表现为无尿或腰痛，术中用利尿剂和靛胭脂后很少发生此并发症，若术中缝扎止血或行膀胱尿道吻合时造成一侧或双侧输尿管梗阻，可等待几日，缝线吸收后可能恢复。置入小号电切镜试图切断缝线是行不通的。经皮暂时肾造瘘可使患者有较长时间等待缝线吸收。

【51】（四）尿管内出血

【52】不需处理，因根治性前列腺切除术中膀胱颈被拉下吻合可很好地控制出血。但术中前列腺蒂及邻近组织的出血较难控制，术后会继续渗血，引流管可防止形成血肿，用沙袋压迫会阴部可减少渗血。迫不得已才重新手术找切口止血，因要找到以前所忽视的出血点需相当麻烦的显露。

【53】（五）尿管阻塞

【54】多由血块引起，需行冲洗。冲洗时如需放松气囊，应将尿管确切地固定在阴茎上。如确需要更换尿管，应立即插入新尿管，最好行膀胱造瘘。

【55】（六）会阴部尿瘘

【56】在置管引流期间若尿瘘持续超过2周应在麻醉下用广视野膀胱镜检查，并行瘘道造影及排尿期膀胱造影。但大部分会阴部尿瘘可自行愈合。

【57】（七）尿失禁

【58】如术中仔细分离尖部尿道一般不会出现，多为暂时性，等待6个月无好转方可考虑手术治疗，如膀胱颈成管或人工括约肌相植入术。

【59】（八）其他并发症

【60】过去经会阴手术后阳痿较常见，但采用保留神经血管束技术后此并发症已减少。术后4～6个月可能出现吻合口狭窄，先用丝状尿道探子扩张至18-20F，如失败可行直视下尿道内切开，手术数年后发生的尿道狭窄可能为肿瘤复发所致。

【61】# 第九章　精囊与前列腺疾病并发症/第六节　根治性耻骨后前列腺切除术并发症

【62】第六节　根治性耻骨后前列腺切除术并发症

【63】【治疗与预防】

【64】（1）直肠损伤应行两层关闭，加盖游离腹膜片或带蒂大网膜。

【65】（2）输尿管损伤应行输尿管膀胱再植术，必要时使用膀胱腰大肌悬吊。

【66】（3）切口感染应用抗生素，必要时引流。

【67】（4）切口浆液囊肿必要时引流。

【68】（5）心肌梗死应急救，请心脏科会诊。

【69】（6）肺栓塞应急救，请肺科会诊。

【70】（7）深静脉血栓应小剂量肝素化、持续穿长筒弹力袜。

【71】（8）肺炎应相应治疗。

【72】（9）淋巴囊肿应在超声引导下穿刺或引流。

【73】（10）导尿管脱落伴尿外渗应在膀胱镜引导下小心试探，重新插入。

【74】（11）闭孔神经切断应行一期吻合。

【75】（12）勃起神经损伤应行体神经移植（疗效有争议）。

【76】（13）吻合口狭窄多数患者仅需扩张，少于10%的患者需要内切开。

【77】# 第九章　精囊与前列腺疾病并发症/第七节　腹腔镜下前列腺癌根治术的手术并发症/

【78】第七节　腹腔镜下前列腺癌根治术的手术并发症

【79】# 第九章　精囊与前列腺疾病并发症/第七节　腹腔镜下前列腺癌根治术的手术并发症/一、尿失禁

【80】一、尿失禁

【81】【概述】

【82】尿失禁是前列腺癌根治术后面临的一个主要问题。如果不给予足够的重视将影响患者术后的生活质量。

【83】【治疗与预防】

【84】腹腔镜手术使用得当可改善手术后患者的控尿质量，利用腹腔镜的放大作用和良好的操作空间（耻骨后），保留后尿道及相关重要的解剖结构，可使LRP术后控尿率达到开放手术组的效果（术后6个月75%～90%）。Srougi术中保留膀胱颈，旨在提高术后尿控率，结果两组术后6个月尿控率均达95%以上，无统计学差异，但保留膀胱颈组外科切缘阳性率达8%。Hollabaugh报道在术中保留潴尿神经，术后控尿高达98%。John报告保留精囊尖部能明显提高术后尿控率。笔者体会到最重要的方法是分离前列腺尖部保留耻骨后血管复合体，在耻骨前列腺韧带下方锐性分离前列尖部，正常判断膀胱颈的位置，注意吻合好膀胱后壁，并将吻合后的膀胱颈前壁与耻骨前腺韧带缝合，能有效减少术后尿失禁发生率。笔者用功能重建技术改进前列尖部的游离和膀胱颈同尿道的吻合技术，明显加快术后患者控尿时间的恢复。

【85】# 第九章　精囊与前列腺疾病并发症/第七节　腹腔镜下前列腺癌根治术的手术并发症/二、阴茎勃起功能

【86】二、阴茎勃起功能

【87】【概述】

【88】腹腔镜能清楚地看见前列腺两侧的血管神经束，术中加以保护。术后2～12个月的随访调查显示，两侧神经保留勃起率40%～87.5%；单侧保留22.2%～51%。

【89】【治疗与预防】

【90】必须重视LRP术的并发症。现将国内外各个医疗中心报道的手术并发症总结如下：再次手术率、中转开放手术、深静脉血栓、输尿管损伤、吻合口漏尿、直肠损伤、尿潴留、回结肠损伤、术后肠梗阻、腹壁下动脉损伤、切口裂开、吻合口狭窄、尿道直肠瘘、髂静脉损伤、膀胱损伤等。

【91】# 第九章　精囊与前列腺疾病并发症/第八节　肺栓塞

【92】第八节　肺栓塞

【93】【概述】

【94】对于前列腺开放手术由于术中术后易于出血，大量止血药物的运用及术后长期卧床，易于诱发静脉血栓形成，血栓脱落易于形成肺栓塞（PE）导致猝死。

【95】【治疗与预防】

【96】对明确PE诊断者要根据不同的临床类型及时治疗，以达到渡过急性危险期，缩小或消除血栓，支持心肺功能和预防再发作的目的。

【97】（1）急救措施：PE后48小时内危险性最大，故患者应就地或进入ICU病房进行血压、心率、呼吸、心电图、中心静脉压和血气监测。

【98】①一般处理：使患者安静、保暖、绝对卧床，胸痛者用止痛剂如吗啡或哌替啶。保持大便通畅，排便勿用力。

【99】②氧疗和呼吸支持：及时吸氧采用鼻导管或面罩给氧，严重低氧血症者进行鼻面罩无创通气或建立人工气道进行机械通气准备，要保持气道通畅，视病情给予支气管舒张剂。

【100】③循环支持：有休克者要补液、纠正酸中毒和给予多巴胺5～10μg/（kg·min）或多巴酚丁胺等升压治疗，维持动脉压大于80mmHg，尿量大于50ml/h，要纠正低血压和休克所致的心律失常等。

【101】④抗生素治疗：要选用适量的抗生素用于控制血栓性静脉炎和预防PE后的继发肺部感染。

【102】（2）溶栓治疗：可迅速溶解血栓和恢复肺组织再灌注，逆转右心衰竭，增加肺毛细血管容量及降低病死率和复发率。

【103】①溶栓指征：2周以内的新鲜血栓栓塞；大块肺血栓；肺血栓伴休克者；原有心肺疾病的次大块肺栓塞引起的循环衰竭者。

【104】②溶栓治疗方案：链激酶负荷量250 000IU/30min，继100 000IU/h，维持24小时静脉滴注，或尿激酶负荷量每10分钟2000IU/Ib，继每小时2000IU/Ib，维持24小时静脉滴注，或rt-PA 500～100mg/2h静脉滴注，较安全。疗效满意。因肺栓塞溶栓治疗不同时并用肝素，故一般不需要做血凝检查监测。溶栓治疗结束后常规继以肝素和华法林抗凝治疗。

【105】③并发症：溶栓治疗并发症出血发生率为5%～7%，致死者约1%。

【106】④溶栓治疗的禁忌证：活动性胃肠出血，2个月内的脑出血，颅、脊术手术后。

【107】（3）抗凝治疗：可防止栓塞发展和再发，使自身纤溶机制溶解已存在的血栓。抗凝治疗1～4周肺动脉血块完全溶解者为25%，4个月后为50%。常用抗凝药物有肝素和华法林。肝素常用于静脉滴注，负荷剂量为2000～3000IU/h，继之750～1000IU/h或15～20IU/（kg·h）维持，根据部分促凝血酶原激酶激活时间（Aptt），调整剂量。亦可应用低分子量肝素。肝素一般用到临床情况平稳，通常7～10天。肝素达到有效治疗水平后，加用口服抗凝剂，华法林成人首次剂量为3～4mg，以后调节剂量，使凝血酶原时间延长到正常的1.5～2.5倍（约16～20秒），凝血酶原活动度降到30%～40%，然后停用肝素治疗。口服抗凝剂的疗程通常为6～12个月。

【108】（4）外科治疗

【109】①肺动脉血栓摘除术：用于伴有休克的大块肺血栓，收缩压低于100mmHg以下者，中心静脉压增高，肾功能不全，内科治疗失败和不宜内科治疗者，手术死亡率较高。

【110】②介入治疗：用猪尾旋转向导管破碎巨大血栓或抽吸取栓，同时也可并用局部溶栓剂。48小时后肺动脉平均压明显不降，较有效为60%，死亡率为20%。都用于溶栓和抗凝治疗禁忌者。

【111】③DVT的治疗：约70%～90%急性肺栓塞的栓子来源于DVT的血栓脱落，特别是下肢静脉尤为常见，因此对急性肺栓塞患者的治疗要重视DVT的检查和处理，防止再发。为防止血栓脱落再发生肺栓塞可在下腔静脉安装滤器等。

【112】# 第九章　精囊与前列腺疾病并发症/第九节　前列腺癌放射性粒子近距离治疗并发症/

【113】第九节　前列腺癌放射性粒子近距离治疗并发症

【114】# 第九章　精囊与前列腺疾病并发症/第九节　前列腺癌放射性粒子近距离治疗并发症/一、泌尿系并发症

【115】一、泌尿系并发症

【116】（一）尿路刺激症状

【117】【治疗】

【118】大多数患者其症状可自发缓解。少数患者需服用盐酸苯偶氯吡胺，泌尿灵等药物缓解症状。

【119】【预防】

【120】尽量减少操作过程相关的创伤，实施恰当的插植放疗计划。如降低中心负荷剂量或放射剂量外周负载型插植可减少急性尿路刺激性。

【121】（二）尿路梗阻症状

【122】【治疗】

【123】大量饮水和限制饮用含咖啡饮料，可缓解部分症状。必要时使用阻断剂以及留置导尿以缓解严重的排尿梗阻症状。0～8.7%的患者因出现明显的排尿梗阻症状或持续性尿潴留须行TURP术。行TURP术时，对于应用L位子的患者应在插到足够的时间使放射性核素完成90%的释放。TURP将切除一些已植入前列腺的放射性粒子，需将切除粒子收集并送交核医学科妥善处理。

【124】【预防】

【125】（1）插植治疗4～6周内应限制剧烈活动。

【126】（2）避免或减少在尿道球部周围以及前列腺近尖部插植放射性粒子。

【127】（3）精确的超声显像和留置Foley尿管有助于更好地显示尿道，减少尿道狭窄并发症。

【128】（4）前列腺体积≤60cm 3 时，应降低放射剂量或降低中心的负荷。

【129】（三）尿失禁

【130】【治疗】

【131】（1）保守治疗

【132】①盆底肌肉训练。

【133】②使用抗胆碱药物或α-受体兴奋剂等药物治疗。

【134】③使用阴茎夹与外部集尿装置。

【135】（2）手术治疗

【136】①尿道周围注射硬化剂。

【137】②接受人工尿道括约肌植入。

【138】【预防】

【139】尿失禁的发生与尿道接受了过量的放射线以及接受TURP有关，因此防止并发症的最好方法是插植期间避免尿道接受太大剂量的放射线，同时也应尽量避免TURP。如果插植后需要接受TURP，那么应尽量减少切除的组织，仅需在小区域内切出一个“通道”；膀胱颈部5点和7点处予以保留，这将保留足够的前列腺尿道部血供；切到前列腺尖部时尽量小心以避免损伤尿道外括约肌。近距离放射治疗前接受过TURP术的患者可具有更高的尿失禁发病率。

【140】对于TURP术后的插植治疗应注意以下几点。

【141】（1）放射性粒子插植点应距离TURP术后缺损处至少1cm，保留1cm正常组织边缘以避免尿道直接暴露于过量的放射线下，防止出现尿道坏死。

【142】（2）接受插植治疗时应避免放射性粒子分布一致。

【143】（3）插植治疗时间需在TURP术后6～8个月进行。

【144】# 第九章　精囊与前列腺疾病并发症/第九节　前列腺癌放射性粒子近距离治疗并发症/二、直肠并发症

【145】二、直肠并发症

【146】【治疗】

【147】早期直肠并发症通常是自限的和可耐受的，症状严重者可以用抗炎药物和氢化可的松栓治疗。保守治疗还包括使用缓泻剂和大便软化剂。外科主要处理尿道直肠瘘，部分患者需要接受长期的耻骨上膀胱切开造瘘。

【148】【预防】

【149】细心操作，减少副损伤，控制放射剂量分布。对于Tle/psa的患者，应降低放射剂量；应严格控制外周负荷型插植治疗中插植位置和剂量分布的精确性；大多数直肠出血可以自行缓解，因此应忠告患者在没有向专业医师咨询的情况下避免接受任何直肠操作，如避免进行直肠活检和避免对直肠前壁的出血区域进行电灼治疗。

【150】# 第九章　精囊与前列腺疾病并发症/第九节　前列腺癌放射性粒子近距离治疗并发症/三、勃起功能障碍

【151】三、勃起功能障碍

【152】【治疗】

【153】可供选择的治疗手段包括使用内分泌等药物；使用尿道内栓剂（前列地尔、前列腺素E1）；阴茎海绵体内注射血管活性药物（如前列腺素、罂粟碱、酚妥拉明）或真空负压助勃装置治疗等。在多大数病例，成功地治疗勃起功能障碍并不困难，必要时行阴茎假体植入。

【154】【预防】

【155】合理的近距离放射治疗计划有助于减少勃起功能障碍发病率。

【156】# 第九章　精囊与前列腺疾病并发症/第九节　前列腺癌放射性粒子近距离治疗并发症/四、粒子移位

【157】四、粒子移位

【158】插植完成后，粒子插植位置应通过超声或荧光窥镜验证。验证后，要取回粒子。那些粒子可植入或送交核医学科回收处理，术后膀胱内旋转Foley尿管，保留尿管连续冲洗，发现粒子要取回放入铅罐，送交核医学科回收处理。如果发生粒子远处移位，粒子将永久停留在肺脏等组织内。但由于是低能量照射，不会对肺组织产生明显的毒副作用。不具有临床意义或潜在的致病率。

【159】# 第九章　精囊与前列腺疾病并发症/第九节　前列腺癌放射性粒子近距离治疗并发症/五、其他并发症

【160】五、其他并发症

【161】（一）血尿

【162】【治疗】

【163】多数症状轻微，可自行缓解。血尿严重者，或出现血凝块而导致潴留时需持续膀胱冲洗。同时可应用抗炎及止血药物。

【164】【预防】

【165】精确的超声影像及插植技术可以限制膀胱颈或尿道的机械性和放射性损伤。

【166】（二）局部血肿

【167】【治疗】

【168】对于针刺部位肿胀、血肿、应用冰袋、止痛药物和抗炎药物，症状可缓解。

【169】【预防】

【170】插植操作后压迫会阴部可以预防皮下血肿出现。

【171】（三）局部感染

【172】【治疗】

【173】全身和局部应用抗菌药物。多饮水、局部理疗及使用松弛膀胱尿道平滑肌的药物可减轻症状。

【174】【预防】

【175】严格遵守无菌原则操作；会阴皮肤或前列腺内有炎性病变时，避免操作；围手术期广谱抗生素的应用仍有争议，但是一些研究报道根据经直肠前列腺活检的数据显示，预防性应用抗生素是有利的。

【176】（四）非特异性会阴部及阴茎疼痛

【177】【概述】

【178】大多数插植后疼痛是相对能较好耐受的。

【179】【治疗】

【180】症状严重者可应用冰袋及抗炎止痛药物。

【181】# 第九章　精囊与前列腺疾病并发症/第十节　前列腺冷冻消融术并发症/

【182】第十节　前列腺冷冻消融术并发症

【183】# 第九章　精囊与前列腺疾病并发症/第十节　前列腺冷冻消融术并发症/一、出血

【184】一、出血

【185】冷冻探头轻轻插入、良好的复温、术后彻底清洗坏死组织及膀胱尿道通畅的冲洗、抗感染治疗是减少出血的重要步骤。一旦发生出血，Foley氏尿管持续压迫多能止血。

【186】# 第九章　精囊与前列腺疾病并发症/第十节　前列腺冷冻消融术并发症/二、感染

【187】二、感染

【188】严格的无菌操作，通畅的冲洗，术前术中预防性应用抗生素可减少感染的发生。笔者习惯经尿道操作前向尿道内注入稀释的碘伏20ml，保留5～10分钟再操作，可能与本组泌尿生殖系感染发生少、程度轻有关。

【189】# 第九章　精囊与前列腺疾病并发症/第十节　前列腺冷冻消融术并发症/三、尿失禁

【190】三、尿失禁

【191】尿失禁大多为一过性、其发生与冷冻定位欠准确，冷冻损伤了尿道括约肌所致，多数经理疗或会阴部括约肌收缩训练好转。需要指出，冷冻加经尿道前列腺切除术（TURP）显著的增加尿失禁的发生率，放疗后复发的病人行冷冻治疗，发生尿失禁的也非常高。

【192】# 第九章　精囊与前列腺疾病并发症/第十节　前列腺冷冻消融术并发症/四、阳痿

【193】四、阳痿

【194】冷冻术后的阳痿不仅是神经源性，而且是血管性的。与传统手术及放疗相比，发生率相差无几，但恢复比手术及放疗快，一般认为阳痿的恢复需2年。

【195】# 第九章　精囊与前列腺疾病并发症/第十节　前列腺冷冻消融术并发症/五、盆腔疼痛、耻骨炎

【196】五、盆腔疼痛、耻骨炎

【197】通常都能自行缓解，症状较重者可给予非甾体类药物。

【198】# 第九章　精囊与前列腺疾病并发症/第十节　前列腺冷冻消融术并发症/六、肾积水

【199】六、肾积水

【200】应在术前及术中仔细定位，防止过度冷冻。

【201】# 第九章　精囊与前列腺疾病并发症/第十节　前列腺冷冻消融术并发症/七、小肠梗阻

【202】七、小肠梗阻

【203】TURP可以显示膀胱穹隆的水平位置。冷冻过程中用生理盐水保持膀胱充盈可以预防此并发症。

【204】# 第九章　精囊与前列腺疾病并发症/第十节　前列腺冷冻消融术并发症/八、尿道狭窄

【205】八、尿道狭窄

【206】冷冻区域腐肉形成可造成膀胱颈部及前列腺部位狭窄，可经尿道切除腐肉。晚期出现瘢痕性狭窄也可经尿道切除。

【207】# 第九章　精囊与前列腺疾病并发症/第十节　前列腺冷冻消融术并发症/九、尿道直肠瘘

【208】九、尿道直肠瘘

【209】【概述】

【210】尿道直肠瘘是前列腺冷冻术最严重的并发症。原因是定位、冷冻温度、冷冻时间控制不准确以及加温仪使用不正确。经尿道的盲目冷冻，应反复直肠指诊协助定位。内镜下冷冻虽然定位较为准确，冷冻时也应结合肛门指诊协助定位。

【211】【治疗与预防】

【212】冷冻时间及温度根据肿瘤大小而定，一般40g以下冷冻5分钟，40g以上8～10分钟，冷冻温度－180～196℃，行2个周期，经尿道盲目冷冻及内镜下冷冻一般肛诊食指不感觉冷感为好，否则有引起尿道直肠瘘的可能。

【213】# 第九章　精囊与前列腺疾病并发症/第十一节　手术去势并发症/

【214】第十一节　手术去势并发症

【215】# 第九章　精囊与前列腺疾病并发症/第十一节　手术去势并发症/一、阴囊血肿

【216】一、阴囊血肿

【217】【概述】

【218】血肿可发生于切口边缘或阴囊壁内，轻者切口渗血不止，重者可形成较大的阴囊壁血肿。

【219】【治疗】

【220】阴囊壁内小血肿或阴囊内血肿不大者可保守治疗，先冷敷或加压包扎，待出血停止后再行热敷或理疗。如伤口引流不断流血或阴囊血肿进行性增大，提示有活动性出血，应拆除缝线清除血肿，结扎活动性出血点并放置引流。找不到出血点可用纱布填塞，再缝口切口，纱布条于48小时后拔除，并应用抗生素预防感染。

【221】【预防】

【222】阴囊血运丰富，在绷紧阴囊皮肤后，可见到血管的走向，阴囊切口应选择阴囊前外方无血管区切开。阴囊组织疏松，减少不必要的过多分离，对可见的出血点均应电凝止血或以细丝线结扎。术后卧床休息，用提睾带或T形带将阴囊托起，并加压包扎。术后放置皮片引流。

【223】# 第九章　精囊与前列腺疾病并发症/第十一节　手术去势并发症/二、阴囊感染

【224】二、阴囊感染

【225】【诊断】

【226】阴囊切口感染表现为局部红肿、疼痛，多无全身不适。阴囊内感染表现为急性阴囊肿大。若阴囊血肿或积液继发感染，则原肿块增大，疼痛重，阴囊皮肤红肿及全身症状。

【227】【治疗】

【228】加强抗感染治疗，应用敏感的抗生素，伤口充分引流，清除坏死组织及残存异物或局部理疗。如有脓肿形成，应切开引流。

【229】【预防】

【230】彻底清创，无菌操作，止血充分，不形成血肿，缝合不留死腔，保持引流通畅，术后排尿排便时不要浸湿及污染敷料及手术切口，若已发生应立即更换敷料。术后根据情况应用抗菌药物预防感染。

【231】# 第九章　精囊与前列腺疾病并发症/第十二节　阴囊、睾丸及输精管手术并发症/

【232】第十二节　阴囊、睾丸及输精管手术并发症

【233】# 第九章　精囊与前列腺疾病并发症/第十二节　阴囊、睾丸及输精管手术并发症/一、阴囊手术并发症

【234】一、阴囊手术并发症

【235】阴囊常见的疾病有阴囊肿瘤和阴囊损伤，阴囊象皮肿已很少见。阴囊损伤分为挫伤和撕脱伤，挫伤经保守治疗可治愈，包括抗生素的应用，卧床休息，抬高阴囊，或配合理疗，使淤血尽快吸收。撕脱伤应尽早清创，一期缝合。阴囊肿瘤少见，良好肿瘤有皮样囊肿、脂肪瘤、纤维瘤等，恶性肿瘤主要有鳞癌和Paget病。

【236】（一）阴囊血肿

【237】【概述】

【238】血肿可发生于切口边缘或阴囊壁内，轻者切口渗血不止，重者可形成较大的阴囊壁血肿。

【239】【治疗】

【240】阴囊壁内小血肿或阴囊内血肿不大者可保守治疗，先冷敷或加压包扎，待出血停止后再行热敷或理疗。如伤口引流不断流血或阴囊血肿进行性增大，提示有活动性出血，应拆除缝线清除血肿，结扎活动性出血点并放置引流。找到不出血点可用纱布填塞，再缝口切口，纱布条于48小时后拔除，并应用抗生素预防感染。

【241】【预防】

【242】阴囊血运丰富，在绷紧阴囊皮肤后，可见到血管的走向，阴囊切口应选择阴囊前外方无血管区切开。阴囊组织疏松，减少不必要的过多分离，对可见的出血点均应电凝止血或以细丝线结扎。术后卧床休息，用提睾带或T形带将阴囊托起，并加压包扎。术后放置皮片引流。

【243】（二）阴囊感染

【244】【概述】

【245】阴囊切口感染表现为局部红肿、疼痛，多无全身不适，阴囊内感染表现为急性阴囊肿大。若阴囊血肿或积液继发感染，则原肿块增大，疼痛重，阴囊皮肤红肿及全身症状。

【246】【治疗】

【247】加强抗感染治疗，应用敏感的抗生素，伤口充分引流，清除坏死组织及残存异物或局部理疗。如有脓肿形成，应切开引流。

【248】【预防】

【249】彻底清创，无菌操作，止血充分，不形成血肿，缝合不留死腔，保持引流通畅，术后排尿排便时不要浸湿及污染敷料及手术切口，若已发生应立即更换敷料。术后根据情况应用抗菌药物预防感染。

【250】（三）皮瓣坏死

【251】【概述】

【252】阴囊撕脱伤致大块皮肤缺损需游离植皮时，由于清创不彻底，切取不够大，缝合有张力及术后固定不好，皮片有移动均可引起皮片坏死。

【253】【预防】

【254】彻底清创，皮片切取要够大，彻底止血，妥善固定加压，避免皮片活动。

【255】【治疗】

【256】一旦出现大片或局部小块坏死应认真处理创面待肉芽长出后行邮票状植皮。

【257】（四）乳糜瘘

【258】【概述】

【259】因淋巴管未严密结扎所致，尤多见于阴囊象皮肿术后。

【260】【治疗】

【261】控制感染后行局部切除，结扎淋巴管或行淋巴管－静脉吻合术。

【262】# 第九章　精囊与前列腺疾病并发症/第十二节　阴囊、睾丸及输精管手术并发症/二、睾丸手术并发症

【263】二、睾丸手术并发症

【264】（一）睾丸下降固定术并发症

【265】1.出血

【266】阴囊内小出血，可给予阴囊冷敷，加压治疗。如术后伤口引流较多或阴囊进行性增大，应拆除缝线，清除血肿，彻底止血并放置引流。

【267】2.睾丸萎缩

【268】术后可应用低分子右旋糖酐或血管扩张剂。术中避免对血管、输精管、精索结构进行过多的分离，减少操作引起的损伤。注意保护睾丸动脉。不应过度牵引精索，固定睾丸张力不应过大，必要时可分期行睾丸下降固定，睾丸引入阴囊过程中避免精索扭转。

【269】3.睾丸回缩

【270】【治疗】

【271】如睾丸回缩到阴囊上部可继续观察，不必手术。若回缩到外环口以上，则于3个月后再次行睾丸固定术。

【272】【预防】

【273】充分游离精索，使睾丸固定后精索无张力。如果高位隐睾，精索虽作充分松解，睾丸仍只能勉强送入阴囊，术后睾丸应作相应的牵引。

【274】4.输精管切断

【275】【治疗】

【276】应立即或成人后行显微输精管吻合术。

【277】【预防】

【278】松解游离精索时应注意输精管的位置及走向，对剪开的组织均应细心观察并用手触及有无管状结构。

【279】5.阴囊肿胀

【280】术后抬高阴囊或用T形带将阴囊托起，并加压包扎，减轻水肿。

【281】（二）鞘膜切除翻转术并发症

【282】鞘膜切除翻转术是治疗睾丸或精索鞘膜积液的一种常用手术，是将多余的睾丸鞘膜切除，然后将剩余鞘膜翻转至睾丸附睾后面进行缝合。

【283】1.阴囊血肿

【284】小的血肿通过通畅引流、阴囊冷敷及加压等治疗。如血肿进行性增大，术后伤口引流物持续有血液流出，应拆除缝线，清除血肿，彻底止血，并放置引流。

【285】2.感染

【286】同阴囊手术。

【287】3.睾丸扭转

【288】【治疗】

【289】早期手术探查，施行睾丸复位固定。若睾丸已坏死，则行睾丸切除。

【290】【预防】

【291】还纳睾丸入阴囊时应检查精索有扭转，术后将睾丸下方的残余鞘膜与阴囊肉膜缝合固定。

【292】4.睾丸萎缩

【293】切除鞘膜需距睾丸2cm，不能残留过少，以免在睾丸背侧缝合鞘膜时张力过大，对睾丸形成压力，尤其是缝合精索处鞘膜应宽松，以免压迫精索血管，影响睾丸血液供应引起萎缩。

【294】（三）睾丸切除术并发症

【295】1.阴囊血肿

【296】【治疗】

【297】出血少者可保持引流通畅，局部冷敷，加压包扎及应用止血药物，多能使出血停止。出血多血肿大时，应及早手术探查止血。

【298】【预防】

【299】切断精索时，精索血管和输精管要分别结扎，以免线结滑脱出血。

【300】2.感染

【301】同阴囊手术。

【302】3.局部肿瘤复发

【303】【治疗】

【304】局部肿瘤复发者应尽量彻底切除，而后行放射治疗或化学药物治疗。

【305】【预防】

【306】已确诊睾丸肿瘤者，均应作腹股沟切口，术中轻柔操作，先阻断精索，然后分离睾丸及鞘膜，切勿损伤睾丸白膜及肿瘤包膜，完整彻底切除。若癌肿破损，则应彻底冲洗，并应用抗癌药物局部浸泡，以杀灭残留癌细胞，防止复发。

【307】（四）附睾切除术并发症

【308】附睾切除术适用于附睾肿瘤、附睾结核及症状重而无再要求生育的慢性附睾炎。附睾结核手术前须使用抗结核药物2周以上或病情稳定时施行，以免发生结核扩散。

【309】1.阴囊血肿

【310】同鞘膜切除翻转术。

【311】2.感染

【312】同阴囊手术。

【313】3.阴囊窦道形成

【314】【治疗】

【315】如有窦道形成，应加强抗结核药物治疗，1个月后再行阴囊窦道切除。

【316】【预防】

【317】附睾结核术前应用抗结核药物至少2周，切断的输精管残断用石炭酸、酒精及盐水涂拭，再用丝线结扎。并将输精管残端经阴囊根部另一皮肤戳口拉出，固定于皮肤上，以免残端引起切口感染，形成窦道。

【318】4.睾丸精索损伤

【319】附睾的病变常致精索、睾丸与附睾紧密粘连，术中分离附睾时应紧贴附睾丸壁进行，在睾丸白膜外找到正确平面分离，如睾丸损伤应立即用细丝线缝合白膜。精索损伤如误将精索内动脉切断结扎，可致睾丸萎缩。如术后睾丸已萎缩，而无任何不适，可不予处理。

【320】5.睾丸扭转

【321】【治疗】

【322】同鞘膜切除翻转术。

【323】【预防】

【324】手术操作轻柔，减轻鞘膜刺激，彻底止血，避免阴囊血肿形成，积极防治阴囊内感染。特别是术中切除多余的鞘膜，或施长鞘膜翻转术，可防止鞘膜积液的发生。

【325】（五）粗索静脉曲张手术并发症

【326】精索内静脉高位结扎术是治疗原发性精索静脉曲张的经典术式，适用于有严重症状非手术治疗无效者，或已引起睾丸生精功能障碍导致不育者。手术有经腹股沟和腹膜后途径。

【327】1.睾丸萎缩

【328】【治疗】

【329】如无不适，可不予治疗。

【330】【预防】

【331】游离精索内静脉时应先找到有搏动的精索内动脉加以保护。

【332】2.术后复发

【333】【概述】

【334】手术后精索静脉曲张的症状和体征不减轻，或短时间内再度出现精索静脉曲张表现。

【335】【治疗】

【336】如复发后症状不重，可用非手术治疗。如症状明显，可经腹膜后途径进行再次手术。

【337】【预防】

【338】术前区分精索静脉曲张是原发还是继发，在未认清精索内静脉及其分支以前，不可将精索血管牵拉过度，否则引起静脉空虚，无法辨认而使静脉结扎遗漏导致术后复发。另外结扎尽量靠近内环口，因该处分支少，不易遗漏。

【339】3.神经损伤

【340】【概述】

【341】髂腹下神经和髂腹股沟神经位于腹外斜肌深面，与肌纹平行，切开腹外斜肌腱膜时易将其损伤，引起下腹部、腹股沟区及阴囊皮肤感觉障碍和下腹壁诸肌的运动障碍。

【342】【治疗与预防】

【343】预防在于仔细解剖。

【344】4.腹股沟疝

【345】经腹股沟途径行精索内静脉高位结扎术，因切开腹股沟管，如腹外斜肌腱膜缝合不良，切口感染，术后大便干燥，剧烈咳嗽等可发生腹股沟疝。因此术中应重叠加强缝合腹外斜肌腱膜，术后避免腹内压增高的因素及防治感染，可防止腹股沟疝的发生。

【346】（六）输精管结扎术后并发症

【347】1.出血

【348】【治疗】

【349】小的出血用冷敷，加压包扎，应用止血药及抗生素治疗。活动性出血，短期内血肿迅速增大，则应立即手术，清除血肿，彻底止血，放置引流。

【350】【预防】

【351】术前严格检查，发现有凝血机制障碍应暂缓手术，合并有鞘膜积液及精索静脉曲张应于节育手术同时处理。手术时应仔细操作，有血管损伤时必须妥善结扎，输精管残断要检查确实无出血后再复位。

【352】2.感染

【353】【治疗】

【354】可引起阴囊局部切口感染和精索、附睾、前列腺、精囊的炎症。应用有效抗生素，局部热敷、精索封闭等治疗，若有脓肿形成，应及时切开引流。

【355】【预防】

【356】严格无菌操作，阴囊皮肤彻底消毒，手术操作认真准确，避免损伤过多组织，彻底止血，对术前有阴囊皮肤疾患及生殖道炎症，应治愈后再行手术。术后保护好伤口，及时更换敷料，短期内禁止性交、淋浴。

【357】3.痛性结节

【358】可用1%普鲁卡因3～5ml加醋酸氢化可的松12.5mg作结节周围浸润封闭，亦可同时加用抗生素和糜蛋白酶。若经各种治疗长期不愈者，可考虑手术切除。

【359】4.附睾淤积症

【360】【治疗】

【361】症状轻者使用提睾带托起阴囊，局部理疗或热水坐浴，以改善局部的血液循环，使附睾的吸收功能增强，同时应节制性生活。症状重者用抗生素加1%普鲁卡因局部封闭，经处理无效时可考虑行附睾切除。

【362】【预防】

【363】避免术中损伤过多而引起血肿和感染，也应避免大块地结扎组织，影响附睾的血液供应及吸收功能。输精管结扎部位宜远离附睾，应在输精管阴囊段的中1/3处，以使近端附睾与输精管有较充裕的缓冲地带。术后避免性交过频并用阴囊托带将阴囊托起。

【364】5.性功能障碍

【365】非器质性病变者进行精神治疗和同时配合一些药物治疗。器质性病变应针对其病因采取有效的治疗措施，在消除这些并发症的同时性功能即可得到恢复。

【366】6.再生育

【367】精液常规检查确实长期有精子，应重新结扎输精管或采取其他节育措施。

【368】# 第十章　女性泌尿外科疾病并发症/

【369】第十章　女性泌尿外科疾病并发症

【370】# 第十章　女性泌尿外科疾病并发症/第一节　女性尿道炎性疾病并发症/

【371】第一节　女性尿道炎性疾病并发症

【372】# 第十章　女性泌尿外科疾病并发症/第一节　女性尿道炎性疾病并发症/一、尿道外口炎症

【373】一、尿道外口炎症

【374】【概述】

【375】尿道外口炎症是指致病病原体引起的尿道外口感染，女性多见。既可单独发生，又可继发于尿道及临近组织器官的感染。

【376】【诊断】

【377】（1）临床表现

【378】①症状：尿道口有烧灼样疼痛，排尿时尤为明显。

【379】②体征：尿道口及周围红肿，黏膜糜烂。急性期尿道外口常有分泌物，多为浆液性或有出血；淋病性尿道口炎多有脓性分泌物。

【380】（2）辅助检查

【381】①中段尿培养及尿三杯试验：可判断有无膀胱和上尿路感染。

【382】②分泌物涂片和培养：可确定致病菌。

【383】【鉴别诊断】

【384】根据症状、体征及辅助检查，诊断并不困难。

【385】【治疗】

【386】（1）选用敏感抗菌药物：口服、肌注或静脉用药。

【387】（2）局部用药：抗生素软膏或PP粉清洗外阴。

【388】# 第十章　女性泌尿外科疾病并发症/第一节　女性尿道炎性疾病并发症/二、尿道炎

【389】二、尿道炎

【390】【概述】

【391】尿道炎是由致病菌引起的尿道感染，女性发病率高，任何年龄可发生。

【392】【诊断】

【393】（1）临床表现

【394】①症状：尿道疼痛和性交疼痛，尿频、尿急、排尿不尽感。

【395】②体征：尿道检查有压痛，尿道有黏液或脓性分泌物，亦可有血尿或脓尿。

【396】（2）辅助检查

【397】①中段尿培养及尿三杯试验：可判断有无膀胱和上尿路感染。

【398】②分泌物涂片和培养：可确定致病菌。

【399】【鉴别诊断】

【400】根据症状、体征及辅助检查，诊断并不困难。

【401】【治疗】

【402】（1）急性尿道炎

【403】①抗菌药物：应用第二、三代头孢类抗生素或喹喏酮类抗生素。一般应用药1周，待症状完全消退、尿道无分泌物后方可停药。

【404】②多饮水，以增加尿液对尿道的冲洗作用。

【405】③对症处理：M-受体拮抗剂能减轻尿频或尿急症状。

【406】（2）慢性尿道炎

【407】①全身应用抗生素同急性期。

【408】②尿道内注射抗菌药物。

【409】③局部理疗。

【410】# 第十章　女性泌尿外科疾病并发症/第一节　女性尿道炎性疾病并发症/三、尿道肉阜

【411】三、尿道肉阜

【412】【概述】

【413】尿道肉阜是生长在女性尿道口红色肿瘤样组织，并非真正的肿瘤，故称之为尿道肉芽肿或血管性息肉。多发生在20～60岁之间。

【414】【诊断】

【415】（1）症状：多数病人有局部疼痛和出血。

【416】（2）体征：肿物位于尿道外口，表面光滑、色红、柔软，易出血。一般0.5～1.0cm大小，有蒂或基底部宽，较大者可呈环形。

【417】【鉴别诊断】

【418】根据症状和体征，可明确诊断。必须经病理检查加以证实，并与尿道癌相鉴别。

【419】【治疗】

【420】（1）较小、无症状者，勿须治疗。

【421】（2）雌激素软膏外用，有一定疗效。合并老年性阴道炎，可用雌激素阴道栓。

【422】（3）长期不愈，可采用电、冷冻、激光或手术切除。

【423】# 第十章　女性泌尿外科疾病并发症/第一节　女性尿道炎性疾病并发症/四、尿道黏膜脱垂

【424】四、尿道黏膜脱垂

【425】【概述】

【426】尿道黏膜脱出并外翻于尿道口之外，称之为尿道黏膜脱垂，也可称为尿道黏膜外翻。

【427】【诊断】

【428】（1）症状：可有尿频、尿急、排尿疼痛等症状。

【429】（2）体征：尿道口肿块，多有明显触痛。

【430】【鉴别诊断】

【431】需与尿道癌和尿道肉阜相鉴别。

【432】【治疗】

【433】一般需要手术治疗，如有急性炎症，则先行抗感染治疗，待急性炎症消退后，再行手术治疗。

【434】# 第十章　女性泌尿外科疾病并发症/第一节　女性尿道炎性疾病并发症/五、尿道憩室

【435】五、尿道憩室

【436】【概述】

【437】尿道憩室是指尿道周围囊腔与尿道相通，女性多见，好发年龄30～40岁。

【438】【诊断与鉴别诊断】

【439】（1）临床表现

【440】①症状：多数病人有反复发作尿频、尿急、尿痛、排尿困难、脓尿，少数病人可无任何症状。

【441】②体征：憩室较大者，阴道检查见阴道前壁有膨出囊性包块，压痛。按压肿块可有脓性分泌物或尿液自尿道口流出，肿块缩小。

【442】（2）辅助检查：可选择尿道镜检查和尿道造影。

【443】【治疗】

【444】经阴道前壁切口行憩室切除术。

【445】# 第十章　女性泌尿外科疾病并发症/第二节　女性膀胱出口梗阻并发症/

【446】第二节　女性膀胱出口梗阻并发症

【447】女性因膀胱颈发生机械性或功能性缩窄，产生梗阻症状，可发生于任何年龄。

【448】主要表现为进行性排尿困难，甚至尿潴留。经阴道触诊膀胱颈部有不同程度增厚。膀胱镜检查是最主要诊断方法，可见膀胱颈后唇抬高，膀胱内有小梁、小室形成。膀胱尿道造影可见膀胱颈开放迟缓或开放不全、颈口狭窄。尿动力学检查，特别影像尿动力学检查对女性膀胱出口梗阻诊断和治疗具有重要的临床指导意义。

【449】需与各种原因引起逼尿肌无力和尿道狭窄相鉴别。

【450】根据尿动力学检查结果，可分析排尿困难原因，制定治疗方案。包括药物治疗：应用a-受体阻滞剂如哈乐、可多华、高特灵、桑塔、那妥、博帝等。手术治疗包括经尿道电切术和尿道扩张术。

【451】# 第十章　女性泌尿外科疾病并发症/第二节　女性膀胱出口梗阻并发症/一、感染

【452】一、感染

【453】【概述】

【454】由于长期排尿不畅，剩余尿增多，导致细菌等病原体感染。

【455】【诊断】

【456】临床表现为尿频、尿急、排尿疼痛，尿液浑浊。尿常规可见大量白细胞。

【457】【鉴别诊断】

【458】需与单纯泌尿系感染相鉴别。

【459】【治疗】

【460】如剩余尿增多，有尿潴留，先引流尿液；积极控制感染，待炎症控制后，行手术治疗。

【461】# 第十章　女性泌尿外科疾病并发症/第二节　女性膀胱出口梗阻并发症/二、肾积水

【462】二、肾积水

【463】【概述】

【464】长期排尿困难，剩余尿增多，慢性尿潴留，导致上尿路排空障碍，肾积水。多表现为双侧肾积水。

【465】【诊断】

【466】临床表现为患侧腰胀痛，有肾叩击痛，B超、X线检查、CT可确诊。

【467】【鉴别诊断】

【468】需与其他原因肾积水相鉴别。

【469】【治疗】

【470】积极治疗原发下尿路梗阻。

【471】# 第十章　女性泌尿外科疾病并发症/第二节　女性膀胱出口梗阻并发症/三、经尿道电切术并发症

【472】三、经尿道电切术并发症

【473】【概述】

【474】主要并发症是电切过深导致尿道穿孔及尿失禁。

【475】【治疗】

【476】多需手术修补和抗尿失禁手术治疗。

【477】【预防】

【478】严格手术适应证，手术操作熟练。

【479】# 第十章　女性泌尿外科疾病并发症/第三节　女性尿瘘并发症/

【480】第三节　女性尿瘘并发症

【481】尿瘘是指尿液部分或全部经异常通道排出体外，导致不同程度尿失禁。

【482】# 第十章　女性泌尿外科疾病并发症/第三节　女性尿瘘并发症/一、输尿管瘘

【483】一、输尿管瘘

【484】【概述】

【485】常见输尿管阴道瘘。

【486】【诊断】

【487】（1）临床表现：持续阴道漏尿，同时有正常排尿。

【488】（2）辅助检查：可选择静脉尿路造影和逆行尿路造影检查。

【489】【鉴别诊断】

【490】需与膀胱阴道瘘和尿道阴道瘘鉴别。

【491】【治疗】

【492】（1）手术治疗：输尿管膀胱吻合术。如缺损较长，则可行膀胱腰大肌吊或膀胱瓣输尿管成形术。

【493】（2）其他治疗。

【494】# 第十章　女性泌尿外科疾病并发症/第三节　女性尿瘘并发症/二、膀胱瘘

【495】二、膀胱瘘

【496】【概述】

【497】主要介绍膀胱阴道瘘。盆腔手术、难产及膀胱放射损伤是其主要原因。

【498】【诊断】

【499】（1）临床表现

【500】①症状：通常手术后7～14天发现阴道流尿，量多或少。

【501】②体征：阴道检查可确定瘘口位置。

【502】（2）辅助检查

【503】①膀胱造影：可发现造影剂进入阴道。

【504】②膀胱镜检查：可发现瘘口大小及部位。

【505】【鉴别诊断】

【506】需与输尿管阴道瘘和尿道阴道瘘鉴别。

【507】【治疗】

【508】（1）几乎所有膀胱阴道瘘都需外科治疗。

【509】（2）手术可经阴道或膀胱途径进行。

【510】# 第十章　女性泌尿外科疾病并发症/第三节　女性尿瘘并发症/三、尿道瘘

【511】三、尿道瘘

【512】【概述】

【513】尿道阴道瘘外伤、手术是其主要原因。

【514】【诊断】

【515】（1）临床表现：如瘘口大，并且位于近段尿道，可有持性漏尿。如瘘口小，并且位于远段尿道，则仅在排尿时有尿液自阴道流出。

【516】（2）辅助检查

【517】①膀胱造影。

【518】②膀胱镜、阴道镜检查。

【519】【鉴别诊断】

【520】需与输尿管异位开口、膀胱阴道瘘、压力性尿失禁鉴别。

【521】【治疗】

【522】几乎都需手术治疗。

【523】# 第十章　女性泌尿外科疾病并发症/第四节　女性尿道肿瘤并发症/

【524】第四节　女性尿道肿瘤并发症

【525】尿道癌女性发病率明显高于男性（4︰1），也是惟一女性患病多于男性的泌尿生殖系肿瘤。原因不明，慢性排尿刺激症状和反复尿路感染可能与尿道癌发生有关。

【526】治疗以手术治疗为主，配合放疗和化疗。治疗方案主要取于肿瘤位置和分期，与病理类型和分级关系较小。早期诊断和治疗是提高疗效的重要措施。前尿道肿瘤可行尿道部分切除，全尿道肿瘤可行前盆腔脏器清除术。

【527】# 第十章　女性泌尿外科疾病并发症/第四节　女性尿道肿瘤并发症/一、阴道感染

【528】一、阴道感染

【529】【概述】

【530】阴道感染系由前盆腔脏器清除术引起的并发症。盆腔分泌物持久经阴道流出，阴道缝合口出血，细菌感染。晚期，可导致阴道挛缩。

【531】【诊断与鉴别诊断】

【532】阴道有分泌物流出，经细菌培养可确诊。

【533】【治疗】

【534】使用抗生素，局部换药；晚期，阴道挛缩，性交困难可行阴道扩张术。

【535】【预防】

【536】早期应用抗生素，预防感染；手术中止血彻底。

【537】# 第十章　女性泌尿外科疾病并发症/第四节　女性尿道肿瘤并发症/二、尿流改道并发症

【538】二、尿流改道并发症

【539】与男性相同。

【540】# 第十章　女性泌尿外科疾病并发症/第五节　女性压力性尿失禁并发症/

【541】第五节　女性压力性尿失禁并发症

【542】女性尿失禁是成年女性常见多发病，据全球统计，女性人群中23%～45%有不同程度的尿失禁，严重尿失禁约为7%，其中约一半为压力性尿失禁。压力性尿失禁（stress urinary incontinence，SUI）指喷嚏、咳嗽或运动等腹压增高时出现不自主的尿液自尿道外口漏出。症状表现为咳嗽、喷嚏、大笑等腹压增加时不自主漏尿。

【543】在增加腹压时，能观测到尿液不自主地从尿道漏出。尿动力学检查表现为充盈性膀胱测压时，在腹压增加而逼尿肌稳定性良好的情况下出现不随意漏尿。随着年龄增长，女性尿失禁患病率逐渐增高，高发年龄为45～55岁。年龄与尿失禁的相关性可能与随着年龄的增长而出现的盆底松弛、雌激素减少和尿道括约肌退行性变等有关。生育的次数、初次生育年龄、生产方式、胎儿的大小及妊娠期间尿失禁的发生率均与产后尿失禁的发生有显著相关性，生育的胎次与尿失禁的发生呈正相关性。盆腔脏器脱垂（pelvic organ prolapse，POP）和压力性尿失禁严重影响中老年妇女的健康和生活质量，压力性尿失禁和盆腔脏器脱垂紧密相关，两者常伴随存在。肥胖女性发生压力性尿失禁的几率显著增高，减肥可降低尿失禁的发生率。

【544】压力性尿失禁诊断主要依据主观症状和客观检查，并需除外其他疾病。

【545】治疗包括保守治疗、药物治疗和手术治疗。

【546】对特殊病例应相机处理，如多次手术或尿外渗导致的盆腔固定患者，在行抗尿失禁手术前应对膀胱颈和后尿道行充分的松解；对尿道无明显移位的Ⅲ型尿失禁患者，术式选择首推为经尿道注射，其次为人工尿道括约肌及尿道中段吊带植入。

【547】无张力尿道中段吊带术，疗效稳定，并发症少，高度推荐作为尿失禁初次和再次手术术式。目前我国较常用尿道中段吊带为TVT和TVT-O，其次为IVS、TOT等。其中TVT-O或TOT因创伤小，住院时间短，并发症少而优势更加明显。

【548】De Lancey于1994年提出尿道中段吊床理论这一全新假说，认为腹压增加时，伴随腹压增加引起的尿道中段闭合压上升，是控尿的主要机制之一。据此，Ulmsten（1996）等应用无张力经阴道尿道中段吊带术（tensionfree-vaginal tape，TVT）治疗压力性尿失禁，为压力性尿失禁的治疗带来了全新的革命。无张力尿道中段吊带术与其他类似吊带手术比较显示，短期疗效均在90%以上，最大优势在于疗效稳定、损伤小、并发症少。

【549】# 第十章　女性泌尿外科疾病并发症/第五节　女性压力性尿失禁并发症/一、TVT手术并发症

【550】一、TVT手术并发症

【551】长期随访结果显示TVT手术治愈率在80%以上，治疗复发性尿失禁时治愈率与原发性尿失禁相似，治疗混合性尿失禁的有效率为85%，对尿道固有括约肌缺陷患者有效率达74%。

【552】（一）膀胱穿孔

【553】【概述】

【554】易发生在初学者或以往施行过手术的患者。

【555】【治疗与预防】

【556】术中反复膀胱镜检查是必不可少的步骤，如果术中出现膀胱穿孔，应重新穿刺安装，并保留尿管1～3天；如术后发现，则应取出TVT，留置尿管1周，待二期再安置TVT吊带。

【557】（二）出血

【558】【概述】

【559】出血及耻骨后血肿并不罕见，多因穿刺过于靠近耻骨后或存在瘢痕组织。

【560】【治疗与预防】

【561】当出现耻骨后间隙出血时，可将膀胱充盈2小时，同时在下腹部加压，阴道内填塞子宫纱条，严密观察，多能自行吸收。

【562】（三）排尿困难

【563】【概述】

【564】多因悬吊过紧所致。另有部分患者可能与术前膀胱逼尿肌收缩力受损/膀胱出口梗阻有关，此类患者进一步行尿动力学检查有所帮助。

【565】【治疗与预防】

【566】对术后早期出现的排尿困难，可作间歇性导尿；约1%～2.8%患者术后出现尿潴留而需切断吊带，可在局麻下经阴道松解或切断TVT吊带，术后排尿困难多立刻消失，而吊带所产生的粘连对压力性尿失禁仍有治疗效果。

【567】（四）其他并发症

【568】包括对置入，吊带的异物反应或切口延迟愈合、吊带侵蚀入，尿道或阴道、肠穿孔和感染等，最严重的是髂血管损伤。

【569】# 第十章　女性泌尿外科疾病并发症/第五节　女性压力性尿失禁并发症/二、TVT-O手术并发症

【570】二、TVT-O手术并发症

【571】【概述】

【572】TVT-O手术近期有效率为84%～90%，与上述TVT手术基本相当，其远期疗效正在进一步观察。

【573】【并发症】

【574】TVT-O和TOT的手术原理与TVT相同，但穿刺路径为经闭孔而非经耻骨后，基本排除了损伤膀胱或髂血管的可能性，但有可能增加阴道损伤的风险。有学者认为，由于穿刺进针方向不同，TVT-O术式安全性高于TOT。

【575】少见的严重并发症主要有吊带阴道侵蚀和闭孔血肿、脓肿形成等。

【576】# 第十章　女性泌尿外科疾病并发症/第五节　女性压力性尿失禁并发症/三、Burch阴道壁悬吊术并发症

【577】三、Burch阴道壁悬吊术并发症

【578】经耻骨后将膀胱底、膀胱颈及近端尿道两侧之阴道壁缝合悬吊于Cooper’s韧带，以提高膀胱颈及近端尿道，从而减少膀胱颈的活动度。分为开放手术和腹腔镜手术二种术式。初次手术时，治愈率在80%以上，再次手术时治愈率与初次手术基本相同，长期随访显示其疗效持久。

【580】发生率为9%～12.5%。

【581】处理方法包括α-受体阻滞剂应用，间歇导尿，尿道扩张等。

【582】（二）逼尿肌过度活动

【583】【概述】

【584】发生率为6.6%～10%。

【585】处理方法包括M-受体拮抗剂应用，排尿训练等。

【587】四、膀胱颈吊带（Sling）术并发症

【588】自膀胱颈及近端尿道下方将膀胱颈向耻骨上方向悬吊并锚定，固定于腹直肌前鞘，以改变膀胱尿道角度，固定膀胱颈和近端尿道，并对尿道产生轻微的压迫作用。吊带材料主要为自身材料，也可为同种移植物，异体或异种移植物以及合成材料。初次手术平均控尿率为82%～85%，客观尿控率为83%～85%，主观尿控率为82%～84%；长期随访10年与1年控尿率并无明显差异。可适用于各型压力性尿失禁，尤其是Ⅱ型和Ⅲ型压力性尿失禁患者。

【29】Abstract

【30】Keratosis pilaris atrophicans faciei (KPAF), also commonly known as ulerythema ophryogenes, is a rare disorder characterized by erythematous small keratotic papules that resolve with atrophy and resultant focal alopecia. This uncommon condition always involves the face, especially the eyebrows. Similarities exist, both genetically and clinically, to other scarring alopecias with follicular hyperkeratosis including atrophoderma vermiculatum and keratosis follicularis spinulosa decalvans. Some have characterized these clinical entities under a single term known as keratosis pilaris atrophicans 通用删除6(英):<u>\[1\]</u>. Currently treatment options produce generally unimpressive clinical outcomes.

【31】50.1 Introduction
-----------------

【32】Keratosis pilaris atrophicans faciei (KPAF), also commonly known as ulerythema ophryogenes, is a rare disorder characterized by erythematous small keratotic papules that resolve with atrophy and resultant focal alopecia. This uncommon condition always involves the face, especially the eyebrows. Similarities exist, both genetically and clinically, to other scarring alopecias with follicular hyperkeratosis including atrophoderma vermiculatum and keratosis follicularis spinulosa decalvans. Some have characterized these clinical entities under a single term known as keratosis pilaris atrophicans 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 1 \]</u>. Currently treatment options produce generally unimpressive clinical outcomes.

【33】50.2 Background
---------------

【34】Keratosis pilaris atrophicans faciei is an autosomal dominantly inherited disorder with incomplete penetrance. Originally described by Englishman Erasmus Wilson in 1878, the clinical findings were named folliculitis rubra 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 \]</u>. In 1889, German Paul Taenzer coined the term ulerythema ophryogenes, meaning scarring of the eyebrows 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 3 \]</u>. Efforts to determine the precise genetic cause are ongoing, but partial monosomy of chromosome 18 is the most frequently cited causation 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 4 – 6 \]</u>. The association of chromosome 18 aneuploidy and KPAF indicates the absence of a gene, possibly for laminin α1, in the 18p area that regulates follicular keratinization and formation of sebaceous gland structures 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 6 \]</u>.

【35】Onset of the disease is noted a few months after birth, with the usual phenotype being Fitzpatrick skin type II, blond-haired boys, with the inherited findings occurring as an autosomal dominant disease with variable penetrance 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 7 \]</u>. Pathogenesis is felt to occur as the result of a plug that forms in the follicular ostium that causes keratotic follicular papules and hair shaft deformation. Histologically, evidence of hyperkeratosis and hypergranulosis of the isthmus and infundibulum of the follicle lead to surrounding inflammation in the dermis. Subsequently, mononuclear cells appear around the superior follicle with surrounding mucin and destructive changes to connective tissue. After the disintegration of the follicle, reactive changes surrounding a naked hair shaft result in further inflammation and finally scarring in the final chronic phase 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 1 \]</u>.

【36】50.3 Clinical Presentation
--------------------------

【37】KPAF begins shortly after birth and is generally clinically evident before 5 years of age with erythema and small horny follicular papules emerging laterally from the eyebrows, often extending to the cheeks and forehead . This condition is often associated with atopic dermatitis, asthma, and seasonal allergies. On exam many patients also often have keratosis pilaris on extremity extensor surfaces 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 8 \]</u>. Eventually the affected areas become atrophic with residual scarring alopecia. The cycle continues through adolescence but generally halts with the beginning of puberty.

【40】50.4 Workup
-----------

【41】Diagnosis is based on clinical findings and may be made soon after birth. Since KPAF is believed to be inherited and is considered a marker of certain genetic syndromes such as Noonan syndrome 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 9 – 11 \]</u>, Rubinstein-Taybi syndrome 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 12 \]</u>, Cornelia de Lange syndrome 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 13 \]</u>, and cardiofaciocutaneous syndrome 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 14 , 15 \]</u>, workup and appropriate treatment for coexisting disease may be initiated.

【42】Histology depends on disease stage. All follicular keratoses form keratotic plugs at the follicular orifice of the infundibulum which makes pathologic diagnosis difficult without relevant clinical history. Therefore, the initial stage of disease is impossible to distinguish between the various forms based on histology alone. The superficial dermis contains a predominantly lymphocytic infiltrate surrounding the follicle with a few neutrophilic granulocytes that progresses to perifollicular fibrosis with fewer lymphocytes over the course of disease. Further, the atrophic stage is characterized by dermal sclerosis, atrophy of hair follicles, and formation of horn cysts. Less commonly, dilated lymph vessels and blood vessels can also be seen. In the final atrophic phase, the disease has the appearance of a cicatricial alopecia.

【43】50.5 Treatment
--------------

【44】There is no apparent universally effective treatment for KPAF. Initial attempts at treatment were tried with antibiotics including sulfa-based medications, macrolides, tetracyclines, and penicillin; all have been shown to be ineffective. Oral isotretinoin has been described as effective by some authors at doses of 1–1.5 mg/kg 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 16 \]</u> but marginal to ineffective by others 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 1 , 17 \]</u>. Topical keratolytics and topical corticosteroids may reduce keratin plugging, obtain mild improvement in the erythema, and slow progression of the alopecia 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 1 , 18 \]</u>. Immunomodulators such as cyclosporine and methotrexate have been reported in other cicatricial alopecias 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 19 – 21 \]</u> but not KPAF and may represent a viable option. Surgical hair transplantation is a viable option for many patients and appears to produce durable hair growth, at least in the eyebrows, that is not susceptible to the lost native facial hair 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 22 , 23 \]</u>.

【45】50.6 Conclusion
---------------

【46】KPAF is a progressive scarring condition affecting the face and the eyebrows. While treatment is challenging, aggressive therapy early after diagnosis may halt progression of the disease and minimize the onset of permanent scarring and alopecia later in life.

【77】Abstract

【78】Acne vulgaris is a disease that typically affects teenagers but may continue into adulthood in some cases. However, acneiform eruptions can occur in the pediatric population from birth onward. Neonatal acne refers to lesions that develop in the neonatal period, from birth through 4 weeks old. Some consider neonatal acne to be synonymous with neonatal cephalic pustulosis. Infantile acne refers to the acneiform eruption that typically presents in children between 1 month and 1 year old 通用删除6(英):<u>\[1\]</u>. Making the correct diagnosis can be a challenge, and in some cases the diagnosis of infantile acne is given whenever comedones are clinically present even if the patient is a neonate.

Neonatal acne refers to lesions that develop in the neonatal period, from birth through 4 weeks old. Some consider neonatal acne to be synonymous with neonatal cephalic pustulosis. Infantile acne refers to the acneiform eruption that typically presents in children between 1 month and 1 year old 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 1 \]</u>. Making the correct diagnosis can be a challenge, and in some cases the diagnosis of infantile acne is given whenever comedones are clinically present even if the patient is a neonate.

【81】51.2 Background
---------------

【82】It is estimated that up to 20 % of newborns develop an acneiform eruption. Neonatal acne occurs much more frequently in boys than girls. Two main theories exist regarding the condition’s pathophysiology. First, maternal androgens are thought to stimulate sebaceous glands in neonates 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 , 3 \]</u>. Second, it is postulated that an increase in neonatal dehydroepiandrosterone (DHEA) stimulates the adrenal glands. There is a questionable association between neonatal acne and the development of acne later in adolescence 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 3 \]</u>.

【83】Neonatal cephalic pustulosis (NCP) is another name given to acneiform eruptions seen in neonates. Some experts consider this a separate entity from true neonatal acne and attribute it to the presence of Malassezia yeast on the skin 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 4 \]</u>. In one study, pustules of the necks of 8 of 13 neonates with acne revealed M . furfur 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 5 \]</u>. However, not all patients with the eruption have positive cultures, suggesting hypersensitivity to yeast as the causative factor rather than level of colonization itself 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 6 – 8 \]</u>.

【84】Little epidemiological data is available on infantile acne, as it so uncommon. Expert opinions suggest that it occurs more commonly in boys than girls. Infantile acne usually presents between 3 and 6 months of age, but it may develop as early as immediately after birth or as late as 1 year old. While pustular lesions may be present in both NCP and infantile acne, the presence of comedonal lesions distinguishes infantile acne from the pustular lesions of neonatal acne/ NCP 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 6 \]</u>.

【85】51.3 Clinical Presentation
--------------------------

【86】Neonatal acne typically presents with pustules and erythematous papules on the cheeks, chin, and forehead . Lesions less commonly affect the neck, chest, or scalp. Comedones may occasionally be present as well. Most cases are mild in severity and self-limited, resolving spontaneously within 3 months 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 \]</u>. NCP patients may present predominantly with pustules and inflammatory papules, but characteristically lack comedones.

【90】51.4 Workup
-----------

【91】When evaluating a newborn with an acneiform eruption, all causes of a pustular eruption should be considered. Common conditions in the differential diagnosis seen in this population are erythema toxicum neonatorum, transient neonatal pustular melanosis, and miliaria. Less commonly, a bacterial, viral, or fungal infection may be present. Other dermatoses to be considered include keratosis pilaris, milia, molluscum contagiosum, sebaceous hyperplasia, or warts. Maternal medications such as lithium or corticosteroids might be causative. In most cases, laboratory evaluation is not necessary. Exceptions are cases in which the neonate demonstrates significant developmental abnormalities 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 6 , 11 \]</u>.

【92】In cases of suspected infantile acne, especially in those with inflammatory lesions, disorders associated with excess corticosteroids or androgens must be evaluated. These include congenital adrenal hyperplasia, a virilizing tumor, or another underlying endocrinopathy. High blood pressure, hand or foot growth, and development of secondary sex characteristics are all signs of an underlying disorder. In children with no signs of abnormalities other than acne, no further workup is needed 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 6 , 11 \]</u>.

【93】51.5 Treatment
--------------

【94】Neonatal acne/NCP is a benign and self-limited condition that resolves within weeks without therapy. However, parents are often concerned and request treatment. In these cases, topical azole antifungals may be prescribed 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 12 \]</u>. Some experts suggest ketoconazole 2 % cream twice daily for 1 week. If lesions persist past 1 month, the patient may in fact have early-onset infantile acne requiring treatment with topical retinoids, benzoyl peroxide, or topical antibiotics 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 6 , 11 \]</u>.

【24】Risk factors vary， depending on family history， previous personal history， and disease， illness， or condition present. 【53】**Clinical Presentation**

【54】During the examination the therapist will begin to get an idea of the client’s overall clinical presentation. The client interview， systems review of the cardiopulmonary， muscu-loskeletal， neuromuscular， and integumentary systems， and assessment of pain patterns and pain types form the basis for the therapist's evaluation and eventual diagnosis.

【55】Assessment of pain and symptoms is often a large part of the interview. In this final section of the text， pain and dysfunction associated with each anatomic part (e.g.， back， chest， shoulder， pelvis， sacrum/SI， hip， and groin) are discussed and differenti-ated as systemic from musculoskeletal whenever possible.

【56】Characteristics of pain such as onset， description， duration， pattern， and aggravating and relieving factors， and associated signs and symptoms are presented in Chapter 3 . Reviewing the comparison in Table 3.2 will assist the therapist with recognition of a systemic versus musculoskeletal presentation of signs and symptoms.

【57】**Effect of Position**

【58】When seen early in the course of symptoms， neck or back pain of a systemic， medical， or viscerogenic origin is usually accompanied by full and painless range of motion (ROM) without limitations. When the pain has been present long enough to cause muscle guarding and splinting， then subse-quent biomechanical changes occur.

【59】Typically， systemic back pain or back pain associated with eVer1other medical conditions is not relieved by recumbency. In fact， bone pain related to metastasis or multiple myeloma tends to be more continuous， progressive， and prominent when the client is recumbent.

【60】Beware of the client with acute backache who is unable to lie still. Almost all clients with regional or nonspecific backache seek the most comfortable position (usually recumbency) and stay in that position. In contrast， individuals with systemic back-ache tend to keep moving trying to find a comfortable position.

【61】In particular， visceral diseases， such as pancreatic neo-plasm， pancreatitis， and posterior penetrating ulcers， often have a systemic backache that causes the client to curl up， sleep in a chair， or pace the floor at night.

【62】Back pain that is unrelieved by rest or a change in posi-tion， or pain that does not fit the expected mechanical or neuromusculoskeletal pattern， should raise a red flag. When the symptoms cannot be reproduced， aggravated， or altered in any way during the examination， additional questions to screen for medical disease are indicated.

【63】**Night Pain**

【64】Pain at night can signal a serious problem such as tumor， infection， or inflammation. Long-standing night pain unal-tered by positional change suggests a space-occupying lesion such as a tumor.

【65】Systemic back pain may get worse at night， especially when caused by vertebral osteomyelitis， septic diskitis， Cushing’s disease， osteomalacia， primary and metastatic cancer， Paget’s disease， ankylosing spondylitis， or tuberculosis of the spine.

【66】**Associated Signs and Symptoms**

【67】After reviewing the client history and identifying pain types or pain patterns， the therapist must ask the client about the presence of additional signs and symptoms. Signs and symp-toms associated with systemic disease or other medical con-ditions are often present but go unidentified， either because the client does not volunteer the information or the therapist does not seek to ask complete questions. To assess for asso-ciated signs and symptoms， the therapist can end the client interview with the following question：

【68】**FOLLOW-UPQUESTION**

【69】Are there any other symptoms anywhere else in your body that you have not told me about or that we have not discussed? They do not have to be related to your back pain or symptoms.

【70】The client with back pain and bloody diarrhea or the person with midthoracic or scapular pain in the presence of nausea and vomiting may not think the two symptoms are related. If the therapist only focuses on the chief complaint of back， neck， shoulder， or other musculoskeletal pain and does not ask about the presence of symptoms anywhere else， an important diagnostic clue may be overlooked.

【71】Other possible associated symptoms may include fatigue， dyspnea， sweating after only minor exertion， and GI symp-toms .

【72】If the therapist fails to ask about associated signs and symptoms， the Review of Systems offers one final step in the screening process that may bring to light important clues.

【3】Psychiatric disorders associated with childbirth are common， both new episodes specifically related to childbirth and recurrences of pre-existing conditions. Pregnancy and childbirth have a combined psychological and physio-logical effect on a woman’s life. Studies have shown that childbearing is associated with a marked increase in incidence and prevalence of psychiatric disorder， although the exact causal mechanisms remain unclear. Postnatal depres-sion is consistently found in 10-15 per cent of mothers. Postpartum psychosis is less common affecting 2 per 1000 deliveries. About 2 per cent of pregnant women using obstetric services have chronic mental health problems.

The majority of women (50-75 per cent) who develop postnatal mental health problems will suffer from mild transitory depressive illnesses，|删除1换行|often with accompanying anxiety (the blues). The risk of developing a severe mental illness， either a severe depressive illness or a puerperal psychosis， is substantially increased， particularly in the first 3months following delivery. These relative risks(RRs) compared to the rest of the female popula-tion can be summarized as follows：

【6】need to see a psychiatrist-RR×7；

【7】need for hospital admission due to a psychosis in the first 3 months following childbirth -RR×324.

【8】The relative risk of developing a new-onset seri-ous psychiatric disorder during pregnancy is lower than at other times； however， obsessive-compulsive disorder becomes worse or can start in pregnancy.

【9】Psychiatric illness leading to suicide is a major cause of maternal death in the UK. Death rates from suicide were very low during preg nancy to within 42 days postpartum but trebled after 6 _V_ weekss to 12 monthspostpartum. However， death rates from suicide within a year after birth are substantially lower than in non-pregnant women (RR 0.09 for pregnancy to within 42 days postpartum group， and 0.31 for6 weeks postpartum to 1 year postpartum group). The women who commit suicide are more likely to do so in a violent way and not as a cry for help.

【10】**Postpartum psychiatric illness**

【11】Psychiatric disorders in the postpartum period are divided into three categories reflecting severity：

【12】maternity (baby) blues；

【13】postpartum depression；

【14】postpartum psychosis.

【15】Maternity blues

This is a minor transitory mood disturbance occurring in 50-75 per cent of women in the first week following delivery， especially after a first baby. Women in the immediate post-partum period may experience mild highs’ as|删除1换行|well as depressive episodes. The cause of‘blues’remains unknown， with the literature being inconsistent on associated factors， such as hor-monal changes and consequently no diagnostic blood tests are indicated.

【17】The “blues’may cause considerable distress to the mother but usually does not require any specificCtreatment other thannreassifanice. Symptoms typically last from a few hours to several days in the immediate postnatal period. These symptoms include tearfulness， sleepless-ness， irritability， impairment of concentration， isolation and headache. The maternity blues are not considered a postpartum depressive dis-order. It is defined by its brevity； should symp-toms persist， then postnatal depression should be considered.

【18】If the symptoms are extreme or prolonged， they must be differentiated from the prodromal features of a puerperal psychosis， which often commences in the same time period. If the symptoms persist over 2 weeks， then a diagnosis of depression should be considered.

【19】Postnatal depression

【20】Postnatal depression is regarded as any non-psychotic depressive illness of mild to moderate severity occurring during the first year follow-ing delivery. The peak onset of depression occurs in the first 6 weeks following childbirth. A recent meta-analysis of nearly 60 studies gives a prevalence rate for postnatal depression of 13per cent. The suffering caused by depression is profound yet often underestimated. Postnatal depression is particularly important because it is so common， and occurs at such a critical time in the lives of the mother， her baby and her fam-ily. It is important that the term ‘postnatal depression'should not be used as a generic term for all mental illness following delivery.

【21】Psychosocial and biological factors have been postulated . These associations have been used by medical professionals to predict and identify women likely to develop postnatal depression and help them access early assessment and treatment. Each subsequent episode may commence earlier in the postpartum period.

【22】Earlier onset depression may in part have an endocrine cause. Massive endocrine changes in circulating sex steroids occur at childbirth. The hypothalamic-pituitary axis must adjust to the sudden loss of placenta and re-establish its reg-ulatory functions in relation to ovarian activity as well as starting lactation.’Oestrogen may have mood-elevating properties： it has been found to be superior to a placebo in treating postnatal depression° and was shown to be an antidepressant in childbearing women. The mechanisms off action， however，remain unclear. Cortisol dysregulation has also been postulated as being causative.3

【23】Diagnosis of postnatal depression may be undetected in up to 50 per cent of cases. The clinical picture is similar to other types of depres-sion； however， other symptoms suggestive of postpartum depression include：

【24】difficulty with practical parenting， including hand-ling or feeding；

【25】feelings of guilt that she is not coping；

【26】expressing excessive concern about the baby's health.

【27】Treatment options are no different to depres-sion occurring at other times. Antidep ressant medication may be indicated and the criteria for prescribing are the same as for non-puerperal depression. Adequate doses should be used and treatment continued for an appropriate length of time. Breast feeding may usually be continued with caution whilst monitoring the baby.

【35】Postpartum psychosis affects women in 1-2per 1000 births. Comparisons of rates across cultures and over time have shown remarkable consistency. This figure has remained consist-ent in England and Wales over the last 50 years despite improvements in medical care and a reduction in maternal mortality rates.

【41】_Psychosis during pregnancy_

【42】Studies have shown a slight but significant reduction in rates of contact with psychiatric serVices and admissions duringFpreg-nancy.11，15-17 However， discontinuation of anti-depressants during pregnancy can precipitate a relapse of depressive symptoms.18 For bipolar illness， pregnancy is usually a time of remis-sion.14，19 Pregnancy does not seem to cause a relapse in pre-existing schizophrenia.20，21

【43】_Psychosis following childbirth (up to 12 months)_ A history of bipolar affective disorder， irrespect-ive of whether the previous episode was puer-peral or not， confers an extremely high risk of relapse following childbirth. The rate rises from a general population risk of 0.1-0.2 per cent to between 25 and 50 per cent (i.e. up to a 500-fold increase in risk).14

【44】Childbearing women with chronic schizo-phrenia of the disorganised type" showed little variation in their symptoms. Women with para-noid psychoses with short episodes of illness or with periods of remission following treatment were at high risk (40 per cent) of recurrence or exacerbation of their illnesses.21

【45】Postnatal management will depend on the type of their illness， with a better outcome for women with ‘positive' symptoms  of schizophrenia both in terms of their response to treatment and their ability to be primary carers for their babies. For mothers with marked neg-ative symptoms， alternative carers will need to be identified as early as possible during the pregnancy， if it is considered that a mother is unlikely to be able to care for the baby.

【22】49.1 Introduction
-----------------

【23】Periorificial granulomatous dermatitis (PGD) was first reported in 1970 in the French literature by Gianotti et al. 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 1 \]</u>. Gianotti et al. 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 1 \]</u> described five Italian children ranging in age from 2.5 to 7 years with a distinctive eruption of monomorphous papules around the mouth with a granulomatous pattern noted histologically. In 1974, Marten et al. 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 \]</u> reported 22 Black children with a similar eruption limited to the face. In 1989, Frieden et al. 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 3 \]</u> termed this disease granulomatous perioral dermatitis in children. In 1990, Williams et al. 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 4 \]</u> reported 5 very similar patients and coined the term facial Afro-Caribbean childhood eruption (FACE) to reflect that all their cases occurred in Afro-Caribbean children. In 1996, Knautz et al. 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 5 \]</u> suggested the term childhood granulomatous periorificial dermatitis for this eruption to point out the frequent perinasal or periocular involvement and to avoid the term FACE which limits the diagnosis to Afro-Caribbeans.

【24】Today, there is still no consensus about the nomenclature of the disease. This characteristic eruption has been reported in the literature as Gianotti-type perioral dermatitis 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 6 \]</u>, facial Afro-Caribbean childhood eruption (FACE) 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 4 , 6 – 9 \]</u>, sarcoid-like granulomatous dermatitis 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 10 \]</u>, childhood granulomatous perioral dermatitis 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 3 \]</u>, and childhood granulomatous periorificial dermatitis 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 4 , 5 , 11 \]</u>. In our opinion periorificial granulomatous dermatitis (PGD) best describes the clinical and histopathologic characteristics of this skin disease because PGD may not be limited to a perioral distribution and is histopathologically characterized by the presence of a granulomatous inflammatory reaction 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 12 \]</u>.

【25】49.2 Background
---------------

【26】The etiology of PGD is unknown, although several theories exist. Many believe that PGD is the less common granulomatous variant of perioral/periorificial dermatitis (PD) and that PD and PGD share the same etiologic factors 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 5 , 13 – 17 \]</u>.

【27】The main etiologic factors in PD are thought to be a decreased stratum corneum (SC) permeability barrier function 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 14 \]</u> from intrinsic factors or deficiencies yet to be identified or from extrinsic causes such as topical products 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 15 , 16 \]</u>. The topical products implicated in PD include contact irritants or allergens in cosmetics and topical corticosteroids (TCs) 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 4 , 11 , 14 , 17 – 20 \]</u>. While there are no reports in the literature demonstrating SC permeability barrier dysfunction in PGD, there are conflicting reports regarding the pathogenic relationship of PGD to topical products. Some authors report a pathogenic relationship between PGD and TC use, or to topical allergens and irritants such as formaldehyde and antiseptic solutions 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 3 , 6 , 13 , 21 \]</u>, while others specifically state that no etiologic relationship is present between TC and other products in PGD 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 22 \]</u>.

【28】Whether the inciting factors are intrinsic or extrinsic, the initiating event for PD as well as PGD is believed to be the same; damage to the hair follicle which results in damage to the follicular wall, release of its contents into the surrounding dermis, and subsequent inflammation 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 14 , 22 \]</u>. The antigenic component of the ruptured follicle is unknown; however, it is thought in PGD to provoke a granulomatous response 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 22 \]</u>. There are limited data available to support this theory of pathogenesis.

【29】PGD is a rare skin disease that occurs mostly in children with skin of color 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 21 , 23 \]</u>. PGD has been seen healthy children ranging in age from 6 months to 18 years 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 17 , 24 , 25 \]</u>. Afro-Caribbean, African American, and Asian children dominate the reports, but Caucasian patients are also susceptible 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 21 , 23 \]</u>. There have been reports of PGD being more common in boys versus girls 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 26 , 27 \]</u>; however, the majority of reports state that both sexes are affected equally 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 21 \]</u>.

【30】49.3 Clinical Presentation
--------------------------

【31】The primary lesions in PGD are discrete 1–3 mm asymptomatic monomorphous dome-shaped papules that can range in color from pink red to flesh colored to yellow brown  通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 12 , 13 , 15 , 22 \]</u>. In some instances there is background erythema and overlying scale present; however, these features are not consistently present in published cases. The face is always involved in PGD, and lesions are typically concentrated around the mouth, nose, and/or eyes. PGD characteristically involves the vermillion border of the lip which helps distinguishes this eruption from other diseases such as PD 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 23 \]</u>. While the majority of cases reported in the literature are confined to the face, eight reported cases of PGD also had generalized skin lesions 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 21 \]</u>. The patients with extrafacial involvement had lesions on the neck, upper trunk, extensor wrists, and vaginal area 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 28 , 29 \]</u>. Importantly, extensive skin involvement in PGD does not appear to change the duration of the eruption, the response to treatment, or have any association with any specific underlying internal diseases 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 15 \]</u>.

【34】Scarring is variable in PGD. The initial cases described by Gianotti et al. 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 1 \]</u> and several subsequent authors 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 6 , 28 , 30 \]</u> reported the occurrence of small pitted scars after resolution of the papules. However, the majority of cases since then have reported no scarring or other sequelae after the resolution of PGD 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 4 , 13 , 23 \]</u>.

【35】In the majority of cases where skin biopsies were performed, a dermal granulomatous infiltrate was seen concentrated around the upper half of the hair follicles 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 12 , 13 , 15 \]</u>. In some biopsy specimens, the granulomatous infiltrate was more diffuse, and in some rare cases no granulomas were detected on histologic examination 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 2 , 4 \]</u>. Focal epidermal spongiosis is occasionally described; however, there is never caseation necrosis, and the results of special stains and cultures for acid-fast bacilli and fungi are always negative 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 15 \]</u>.

【36】This granulomatous histologic appearance of PGD is not diagnostic. The differential diagnosis of small papules with granulomatous histologic features in children includes sarcoidosis, fungal or mycobacterial infection, familial juvenile systemic granulomatosis (Blau syndrome), and granulomatous rosacea in addition to PGD 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 15 \]</u>. In typical cases of PGD, these entities can be differentiated clinically; however, in cases with extrafacial involvement, a more thorough workup may be needed to establish the diagnosis and exclude other entities in the differential diagnosis.

【37】49.4 Workup
-----------

【38】There is some disagreement concerning the recommended workup when the diagnosis of PGD is suspected. Because PGD occurs in healthy children and spontaneously resolves within a few months to years without scarring or sequelae, it is often difficult to justify a biopsy or a thorough systemic evaluation 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 4 \]</u>. However, it can be difficult at times to differentiate PGD from other more serious conditions with extracutaneous manifestations and potential long-term detrimental sequelae 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 23 \]</u>. For this reason, when clinical presentation is not sufficient to diagnose PGD 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 4 , 31 \]</u>, histopathologic evaluation is recommended, with additional workup directed by the clinician based on the needs of the individual case. Examples of tests that may be included in the workup are chest radiograph, ophthalmologic examination, tuberculin skin test, serum calcium, serum angiotensin-converting enzyme level, and the use of special stains and tissue cultures for fungal or mycobacterial organisms on histologic sections  通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 15 , 22 , 31 , 32 \]</u>.

【52】Less commonly reported skin diseases which should be included in the differential diagnosis of PGD include allergic/irritant contact dermatitis, impetigo, acrodermatitis enteropathica, tinea faciei, lip-lickers dermatitis, atopic dermatitis, benign cephalic histiocytosis, granulosis rubra nasi, glucagonoma syndrome, Blau syndrome, Haber syndrome, and facial demodicosis.

【53】49.5 Treatment
--------------

【54】Patients and parents should be reassured that PGD is a benign, self-limited condition. Since the disease is benign and self-limited, treatment may be unnecessary. However, the average reported time for spontaneous resolution is between 1 and 3 years 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 1 , 6 , 10 , 30 , 33 – 36 \]</u>, and the resolution may be hastened with the use of appropriate therapy 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 15 \]</u>. The time to resolution with treatment varies greatly in the literature ranging from 1 week to 6 months 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 17 , 20 , 37 \]</u>.

【55】There are no available randomized controlled trials providing guidance for the best treatment in PGD because of the rare nature of this skin disease. Some reviews dictate the first step in management to be discontinuation of all TCs or any other possible inciting chemicals or products 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 12 , 13 , 24 , 34 \]</u>. Because there may be an associated rebound or exacerbation of the skin disease after stopping TC use, many physicians recommend the use of a mild topical corticosteroids daily for a few weeks to effectively wean patients off more potent TCs; however, there is no scientific evidence that this approach is beneficial 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 25 , 37 , 38 \]</u>. The authors suggest discontinuation of TCs without a weaning approach 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 39 \]</u>.

【56】In the literature there are several case reports demonstrating the effectiveness of treatment with topical metronidazole, sulfacetamide-sulfur, topical erythromycin, oral tetracyclines, or oral erythromycin for PGD 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 4 , 15 , 21 \]</u>. Nguyen and Eichenfeld 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 17 \]</u> recommend a 1–2-month trial of topical metronidazole with the addition of oral erythromycin. Urbatsch states that the administration of oral macrolides or tetracyclines, alone or in combination with topical erythromycin, metronidazole, or sulfur-based lotions, hastens resolution in most patients 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 15 , 21 \]</u>. Although oral tetracyclines can be effective in treating PGD, they should not be used in PGD patients less than 8 years old as tetracyclines have been known to cause dental enamel discoloration 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 24 , 39 \]</u>. The availability of subantimicrobial dosing of doxycycline offers an option that may be effective without exposing the patient to antibiotic selection pressure 通用删除6(英):<u>\[ 39 \]</u>.

【57】49.6 Conclusion
---------------

【58】PGD is a chronic and potentially disfiguring dermatosis, often affecting the face. It may commonly be mistaken for acne vulgaris, but clinically appears as monomorphic papules rather than the comedones, papules, and pustules observed in patients with acne vulgaris. Treatment can be challenging and requires often long-term combination therapy with both topical and oral medications.

While it is impossible to define what constitutes ‘adequate exposure’ for language acquisition, some language-learning environments are associated with delayed or disordered acquisition of phonology. The one that has received most research attention is that of multiple-birth children. They have been reported to have delayed communication development compared with singletons in terms of age of speech onset, syntax, vocabulary, pragmatics and particularly phonology 删除1:<u>(Savic, 1980; McMahon and Dodd, 1995)</u>. Any children whose primary communicative partners are children of a similar age (siblings close in age or children in long day care) may also be exposed to the factors placing twins at risk.

【2】Finally, some children grow up in very stressful environments. Their opportunity to engage in the pleasurable communicative interactions that are important for language learning may be rare; they may be exposed to abuse or their communicative attempts may be punished 删除1:<u>(van Riper, 1963)</u>. Nation and Aram (1984, p. 24) conclude that such generalities ‘provide insufficient information for causal interpretation’. Nevertheless, there appears to be a consensus that emotional factors may be causal as well as consequent factors of speech disorders 删除1:<u>(Weiss et al. 1987)</u>.

【3】Maintenance factors operate to constrain change, and can minimize the benefits of intervention. Many of the causal factors already discussed can also be maintenance factors (e.g. periods of impaired hearing, limited opportunities for language-learning interaction or an elder sibling ‘talking for’ the speech-disordered child). Other examples of maintenance factors are: speech and language therapy being such a positive experience the child does not want to attain error-free speech, parents rewarding ‘cute’ speech errors and disordered speech being accepted as an excuse for not being required to perform particular tasks or activities. One explanation for disordered speech, sometimes offered by care givers, is ‘laziness’. There is no evidence to support this hypothesis, and caregivers may need to be counselled concerning their belief that speech disorders reflect an unwillingness to put enough effort into learning pronunciation. Most textbooks conclude that it is rarely possible to identify a single causal factor. For example, some research suggests that fluctuating hearing loss is more likely to be associated with speech disorder in children from lower-socio-economic groups 删除1:<u>(Teele et al. 1984)</u>. However, no causal or maintenance factors can be identified as underpinning some children’s speech disorder. While awareness of the factors that contribute to a child’s disordered speech is useful in planning clinical management, knowledge of the causal factors is not essential for the provision of appropriate intervention, providing that all possible causal factors have been considered and ruled out.

【4】### _Age of onset_

【5】Three categories for age of onset are listed on the chart.

【6】(a) _Congenital_ . That some children are at great risk for communication disorder is apparent at birth (e.g. sensory or intellectual impairment, cerebral palsy or anatomical anomaly).

【7】(b) _Developmental_ . Most speech difficulties emerge during the preschool years. Speech onset may be delayed and development slow; alternatively, a child may begin to produce words at the appropriate age but the type of errors made may indicate disordered development 删除1:<u>(Leahy and Dodd, 1987)</u>.

【8】(c) _Acquired_ . Children who have acquired a sensory impairment are considered advantaged compared with children with congenital sensory loss in terms of communicative development. While young children with acquired communication disorders due to neurological damage were considered to have a good prognosis, this view has been challenged 删除1:<u>(Jordan et al. 1990)</u>. For example, Hudson-Tennent (1993, p. 341) concludes that ‘children diagnosed and treated for posterior fossa tumour when less than six years of age are likely to retain developmental phonological error patterns in the long term’.

【9】5\. Initial management decisions
--------------------------------

【10】The final section of the chart encourages the interpretation of the summarized data in terms of initial clinical decisions. One of the first of these decisions concerns what type of additional assessment information is required regarding the child’s communication skills. Many speech-disordered children have additional disorders of expressive language, and there may be a need to assess syntactic, lexical and pragmatic abilities. However, children whose speech is difficult to understand often adopt strategies that maximize their intelligibility that affect measures of syntax and semantics. They minimize the length and complexity of their utterances and tend to use generic rather than specific terms 删除1:<u>(e.g. despite being able to distinguish receptively between policeman and doctor, they refer to both as ‘man’, Brierly, 1987)</u>. Children who are aware of their speech disorder may also limit their use of language, performing poorly on pragmatic measures. The results of assessment of other expressive language abilities must, then, be taken in the context of the speech disorder, particularly if tests of language comprehension reveal age-appropriate performance. It is also often necessary to refer children to other professionals (e.g. audiologist, psychologist or ear-nose-throat specialist) for their assessment of a child’s abilities, in order to gauge the importance of suspected causal factors. Section 5 provides a space for listing intended referrals.

【11】The procedure for summarizing information which is outlined in this section allows for the classification of subgroups of speech disorder:

【12】*   articulation vs. phonological;
*   delayed phonological development vs. consistent phonological disorder vs. inconsistent phonological disorder;
*   organic vs. environmental causal and maintenance factors;
*   severity – PPC, concern and consequences.

【13】These data allow clinical decisions about the need for intervention and choice of intervention approach. When considering the intervention approach, there are two important sets of decisions that are, to some extent, interdependent: service delivery and therapeutic goals.

【14】# PART II: TREATMENT OF PHONOLOGICAL DISORDERS/CHAPTER 8: A procedure for classification of speech disorders/What service delivery option will be chosen?

【15】What service delivery option will be chosen?
============================================

【16】Chapter 7 discusses the decisions that need to be considered: agent of therapy, one-to-one or group therapy, length of session, scheduling of therapy, length of episode of care, therapy site and other professionals involved in care. Clinical experience suggests that a diagnosis of subgroup of speech disorder should influence the choice of service delivery. Articulation disorder is more likely to be treated by an agent of therapy 删除1:<u>(e.g. Costello and Schoen, 1978)</u>, as are children with an intellectual impairment 删除1:<u>(Dodd et al. 1995)</u>. Children with a phonological delay have been shown to improve in group therapy using an intensive whole language approach 删除1:<u>(Alcorn et al. 1995)</u>. Treatment programmes for phonological disorder usually indicate that children are seen individually either weekly or twice weekly for around six hours for between six and twelve weeks 删除1:<u>(Leahy and Dodd, 1987; Holm and Dodd, 1999b; Dodd and Bradford, 2000; Bleile, 2002; Khan, 2002; Miccio, 2002)</u>.

【17】There is, then, huge variation in the amount of therapy children receive. As examples, Deitrich and Bangert (1980) provided 32 sessions over a 10-month period (although one-quarter of the children failed to attain the therapy goals set) as compared to Rvachew and Nowak (2001), who provided six sessions, weekly, of 30–40 minutes in any one episode of care. Khan (2002) prefers to see children twice weekly initially, followed by weekly sessions. It seems obvious that different children would need different amounts of therapy, which could be scheduled intensively, weekly or less frequently.

【18】All children referred for assessment have caregivers and teachers who are likely to be concerned about their children’s communication difficulties. Other professionals may also be involved (e.g. general practitioners, audiologists and educational psychologists). Some clinics routinely assess caregiver satisfaction with services 删除1:<u>(Rvachew and Nowak, 2001)</u>. There appears, however, to be little research evaluating the roles of caregivers and other professionals in promoting efficacy of therapy, other than some research projects that have designated parents or teachers as the sole agent of therapy 删除1:<u>(e.g. Wulz et al. 1983)</u>. Service delivery decisions need to be made individually, rather than one policy applied to all children referred to a particular service. Nevertheless, research bearing on service delivery issues, particularly in relation to subgroups of speech disorder, is needed so that clinicians can maximize their effectiveness.

【19】# PART II: TREATMENT OF PHONOLOGICAL DISORDERS/CHAPTER 8: A procedure for classification of speech disorders/What are the goals of therapy?

【20】What are the goals of therapy?
==============================

【21】Chapter 7 discusses the three goals that need to be considered: the ultimate goal (prognosis), the long-term goal (for a particular episode of care) and the short-term goals (sequence of abilities to be learned that build towards the long-term goal). For therapy to be successful, the long-term goal needs to target the particular level or levels of breakdown in the speech-processing chain that are reflected by surface speech error patterns. Clinicians interpret assessment data to make three important clinical decisions.

【22】1 What unit of speech will be the target of therapy: speech sound, error pattern, whole word or whole language?

【23】2\. What tokens of the unit chosen should be selected as targets in therapy?

【24】3\. Which intervention technique should be selected?

【25】Research suggests that subgroups of speech disorder are best remediated by therapy that targets specific units of speech, using particular intervention approaches .

They are best treated by therapy that focuses on the motoric production of individual speech sounds using the approach originally described by van Riper (1963).

Children with delayed phonology respond best to therapy that focuses on error patterns, using phonological contrast therapy 删除1:<u>(e.g. Metaphon, Howell and Dean, 1994)</u>. 【33】**Phonological approaches to intervention**
===========================================

【34】A LISON H OLM , S HARON C ROSBIE AND B ARBARA D ODD

【35】Phonological disorders reflect deficits in the cognitive-linguistic processes involved in producing speech. These deficits result in a disordered linguistic system, and the aim of phonological therapy is to re-organize a child’s linguistic system. Differing theoretical accounts and analysis procedures described in the literature are associated with differing clinical approaches. Speech and language pathologists (SLPs) are confronted with a range of options regarding how to achieve re-organization of a child’s phonological system. Some important choices include:

【36】1\. Intervention target selection: phonological error patterns versus specific sounds versus specific distinctive features, stimulable versus non-stimulable sounds, complex versus simple phonological features, marked versus unmarked speech sounds, aspects of a child’s speech-sound system reflecting most knowledge versus least knowledge and inconsistent versus consistent errors.

【37】2\. The number of contrasts targeted: two target sounds, target versus error contrasts, minimal pairs (word pairs that differ in one feature, e.g. pin and bin), maximal pairs (word pairs that have two contrasting sounds that differ in terms of both manner and place of articulation and voicing, e.g. bun and sun), many contrasts within a phonological error pattern (e.g. for final consonant deletion pie, pipe, pine, pile, pies) and multiple oppositions across a phoneme collapse (e.g. where /d/ is substituted for all plosives – tea, pea, bee, key, ghee).

【38】3\. Approaches to delivery of the intervention: goal attack strategies, specific intervention paradigms, decision criterion, methods of teaching and reinforcing, nature of words used in intervention and materials used.

【39】This chapter will explore these available options. A case study will be provided to give an example of how phonological intervention may be effectively used to create the cognitive reorganization of a phonological system.

【40】# PART II: TREATMENT OF PHONOLOGICAL DISORDERS/CHAPTER 9: Phonological approaches to intervention/Phonological versus articulatory disorders

【41】Phonological versus articulatory disorders
==========================================

【42】Before discussing the clinical management decisions necessary for the delivery of intervention of phonological disorders, it is necessary to comment on the use of the terms ‘articulation’ and ‘phonology’. The literature sometimes uses the term ‘phonological disorder’ to encompass both articulation and phonological disorders 删除1:<u>(e.g. Gierut, 1998)</u>, perhaps because the two disorders can co-occur 删除1:<u>(Fey, 1992)</u>. We argue that it is essential to differentially diagnose articulation from phonological disorders, as the two are caused by different deficits in the speech-processing chain, and clinical efficacy research shows that the two disorders respond best to different therapeutic approaches 删除1:<u>(Holm et al. 1997)</u>. Articulation errors arise from an impaired ability to programme correctly the motor movements for the correct ‘phonetic’ version of a sound (e.g. lisp). By linguistic definition, phonology concerns language-specific knowledge of phonemes and how they may be combined to make up words. In this chapter, we focus on phonological errors.

【43】# PART II: TREATMENT OF PHONOLOGICAL DISORDERS/CHAPTER 9: Phonological approaches to intervention/Rationale for using phonological intervention

【44】Rationale for using phonological intervention
=============================================

【45】Chapter 3 presents evidence that there are two groups of children whose speech errors are relatively consistent and can be described in terms of phonological error patterns or rules: children with delayed phonological development and children with consistently applied atypical error patterns. These two groups of children require intervention that re-organizes their linguistic systems. Phonological contrast intervention is only suitable for children who have identifiable patterns in their speech. It is not suitable for children with inconsistent speech, because they do not have identifiable patterns . It is also not suitable for children with a motoric basis to their speech disorder, as it does not directly target an articulatory deficit: phonological intervention assumes stimulability of the sounds being targeted .

【46】Phonological delay
------------------

【47】Children with phonological delay follow the normal sequence of development but take longer than typically developing children to progress through the sequence. Sometimes, a child’s phonological system becomes ‘frozen’ (no further spontaneous change occurs) at a particular point in the sequence of development towards mastery of the age appropriate range of contrasts within their language. Little is known about the cause of phonological delay. Studies of the natural history of delay suggest that some delayed children remain delayed, others achieve age-appropriate speech and some typically developing children become delayed 删除1:<u>(Dodd et al. 2000)</u>. There are, therefore, valid clinical reasons for providing intervention for these children.

【48】It might be argued that children with mildly delayed phonological development (a delay of six to twelve months) do not really require phonological intervention. The delay may be resolved by attendance at preschool that focuses on language, or a home programme (given appropriate caregiver skills). These children’s progress would need to be monitored by an SLP. Intervention is indicated if children’s development is arrested or they are using a large number of patterns simultaneously and consistently to a far greater extent than younger children. For these children with severely delayed development, intervention is warranted to improve their intelligibility and allow them better communicative competence. Research suggests two therapeutic options: phonological therapy  and whole language therapy .

【49】Consistent atypical errors
--------------------------

【50】It has been hypothesized that children using atypical error patterns have difficulty accurately abstracting information about their phonological system . This inaccuracy results in non-developmental error patterns (e.g. all word-initial consonants are realized as /h/). They have a cognitive-linguistic basis for their disorder. Our research indicates that the best therapeutic approach for children who use atypical error patterns focuses on those error patterns 删除1:<u>(Holm et al. 1997; Dodd and Bradford, 2000)</u>.

【51】Basis and aims of intervention
------------------------------

【52】Phonological intervention needs to address the function and use of sounds (in contrast to approaches that target articulation using a phonetic basis) for both children with severe delay and those who consistently use atypical errors. The ultimate goal of phonological intervention is for the child’s speech to become appropriate for their age. This process requires cognitive reorganization of the child’s sound system – often using an emphasis on meaning to highlight the communicative importance of the reorgani
